ప్రొవైడ్ చేస్తాం అనేది చెప్తున్నారన్నమాట. ఈ ఎలక్ట్రిక్ బైక్ ని గుజరాత్ సిఎం గారి చేతుల మీదగా అయితే రివీల్ చేశారన్నమాట. ఇక ఈ ఎలక్ట్రిక్ బైక్ లో మల్టిపుల్ వేరియంట్స్ కూడా అందుబాటులోకి తీసుకొస్తా అంటున్నారు. ఈరోజు మన వీడియోలో ఎవోర్ ఎలక్ట్రిక్ బైక్ కి సంబంధించిన వేరియంట్స్ ఏమున్నాయో? ఇందులో ఉన్న టెక్నికల్ స్పెక్ట్స్ ఏంటి? ఫీచర్స్ ఏంటి? కంప్లీట్ డీటెయిల్స్ ని ఈరోజు మన MVS ఆటో తెలుగు ఛానల్ లో తెలుసుకుందాం. నమస్తే, నేను మీ కృష్ణ చైతన్య మండేలా. మీరు చూస్తున్నారు MVS ఆటో తెలుగు. ఎలక్ట్రిక్ వెహికల్ రంగంలో అడుగుపెట్టాలనుకుంటున్నారా? కానీ ఎక్కడి నుంచి ప్రారంభించాలో అర్థం కావడం లేదా? సరైన ఈవి డీలర్షిప్ ఎంపిక నుంచి, లాభదాయకమైన ఛార్జింగ్ స్టేషన్ ప్లానింగ్ వరకు, మీ అవసరానికి సరిపోయే ఈవి వెహికల్ సెలెక్షన్ నుంచి, కాలేజీ ప్రాజెక్టులకు టెక్నికల్ గైడెన్స్ వరకు, ప్రతి దశలో మీకు తోడుగా ఉంటుంది, ఈవి కుర్రాడు. అనుభవంతో కూడిన నిపుణుల సలహా, స్పష్టమైన మార్గదర్శకం, సరైన నిర్ణయానికి నమ్మకమైన సహాయం. ఈరోజే స్క్రీన్ పై కనిపిస్తున్న వాట్సాప్ నెంబర్ కు మెసేజ్ చేయండి, మీ ఈవి ప్రయాణాన్ని ఆత్మవిశ్వాసంతో ప్రారంభించండి. సో ఎవోర్ కి సంబంధించిన ఎలక్ట్రిక్ బైక్ డిజైన్ అయితే ఇలా కనిపిస్తుందన్నమాట. ఇది వచ్చి EX 2S అనే ఒక పేరుతో అయితే ఈ బైక్ ని అయితే మార్కెట్ లోకి అయితే రిలీజ్ చేశారన్నమాట. సో మీకు సైడ్ ప్రొఫైల్ అయితే ఇలా కనిపిస్తుంది. సో కలర్ ఆప్షన్స్ కూడా ఉన్నాయి. రెడ్ కలర్, అలానే బ్లూ కలర్, బ్లాక్ కలర్, గ్రే కలర్ ఇలా మొత్తం ఫోర్ కలర్ ఆప్షన్స్ లో అయితే అందిస్తున్నారన్నమాట. సో ఇందులో వీళ్ల టాప్ ఎండ్ వేరియంట్ వచ్చి 5 కిలోవాట్ల బ్యాటరీ ప్యాక్ కెపాసిటీతో 260 కిలోమీటర్ల వరకు IDC రేంజ్ అనేది కంపెనీ వాళ్ళైతే క్లెయిమ్ చేస్తున్నారు. అలాగే ఈ ఎలక్ట్రిక్ బైక్ లో 114 కిలోమీటర్ల టాప్ స్పీడ్ కూడా లభిస్తుంది అనేది చెప్తున్నారు అన్నమాట. ఇక బైక్ పరంగా చూసుకున్నట్లయితే కాస్త పెట్రోల్ బైక్ లుక్ లాగానే కనిపిస్తుంది అన్నమాట. ఒక్కొక్క యాంగిల్ లో మనకి బైక్ అయితే ఇలా కనిపిస్తుంది అన్నమాట. సో ముందు వెనక కూడా మీకు డిస్క్ బ్రేక్స్ తోనే ఈ ఎలక్ట్రిక్ బైక్ అయితే లభిస్తుంది. ఇక చార్జర్ చూసుకున్నట్లయితే ఫ్రంట్ సైడ్ మీకు బూట్ స్పేస్ లాగా ఉంటుంది. దాన్ని ఓపెన్ చేస్తే మీకు చార్జర్ కేబుల్ అయితే తీసుకుని మీరైతే చార్జింగ్ అయితే పెట్టుకోవచ్చు అని చెప్తున్నారు అన్నమాట. అలానే వీళ్ళు చెప్తున్న విషయం ఏమిటంటే ఫాస్ట్ చార్జింగ్ అవుతుంది. ఎవ్రీ మినిట్ కి 1.2 కిలోమీటర్లు చార్జింగ్ అయితే చేసుకోవచ్చు అనేది చెప్తున్నారు అన్నమాట. అలానే 15 ఆంప్స్ వాల్ అవుట్లెట్ దగ్గర అయితే మీరు చార్జింగ్ పెట్టుకుంటే ఇంత ఫాస్ట్ గా అయితే చార్జింగ్ అయితే చేసుకోవచ్చు అనేది క్లైమ్ చేస్తున్నారు. అలానే ఈ బైక్ లో మొత్తం ఫైవ్ రైడ్ మోడ్స్ అయితే లభిస్తాయి అనేది చెప్తున్నారు అన్నమాట. ఇందులో మీకు ఎకో, సిటీ, ప్యామ్ ప్లస్, స్పోర్ట్స్, అపెక్స్ మొత్తం ఐదు మోడ్స్ లో అయితే మీకు ఎలక్ట్రిక్ బైక్ అయితే లభిస్తుంది అని చెప్తున్నారు. దీంట్లో మీకు 10.5 కిలోవాట్ల పీక్ పవర్ ఎలక్ట్రిక్ మోటార్ అయితే యూస్ చే

title: 260 km Range- Avore Electric Bike Launch India - Mvs AutoTelugu
transcription: చేస్తున్నారన్నమాట. ఈ బైక్‌లో మీకు బ్యాటరీ ప్యాక్ అనేది ఇక్కడైతే ఉంటుందన్నమాట. అలానే ఇందులో వీళ్ళు చెప్తున్నదేంటంటే యాక్టివ్ కూలింగ్ అనేది లభిస్తుందని చెప్తున్నారు, IP67 ప్రొటెక్షన్ కూడా ఈ పర్టికులర్ బ్యాటరీ ప్యాక్ కి లభిస్తుందని చెప్తున్నారు. ఇక ఈ ఎలక్ట్రిక్ బైక్‌లో ఇంకొక ఇంట్రెస్టింగ్ ఫీచర్‌ని కూడా వీళ్ళు యాడ్ చేసినట్టు అయితే చెప్తున్నారు. దీని పేరేం చెప్తున్నారంటే SYFT అని ఒక ఫీచర్ అన్నమాట. సో వాస్తవానికి ఇదొక గేర్‌లెస్ బైక్. అంటే ఇందులో ఎటువంటి గేర్లు అనేవి మీరు యూస్ చేయాల్సిన అవసరం లేదు. బట్ వీళ్ళు ఏం చెప్తున్నారంటే ఒక పెట్రోల్ బైక్ ఫీల్‌ని కంటిన్యూ చేయాలనే ఉద్దేశంతో ఆర్టిఫిషియల్‌గా గేర్స్ కింద అయితే ఏర్పాటు చేసామనేది చెప్తున్నారన్నమాట. ఇక్కడ మీకు ఆ గేర్ లాగా ఉంటుంది. అంటే మనం నార్మల్ బైక్ నడుపుతున్నప్పుడు అక్కడ క్లచ్ నొక్కి మన గేర్స్ చేంజెస్ చేస్తాం కదా, సేమ్ అలాగే పెట్రోల్ బైక్ ఫీల్ ఇవ్వడం కోసం కింద మనకి గేర్ లాంటిదయితే ఇస్తారన్నమాట. బట్ నిజానికి ఇది గేర్ కాదు. ఇక్కడ ఏంటంటే ఒక టార్క్‌ని కంట్రోల్ చేసే ఒక సిస్టమ్ అన్నమాట. సో మీకు ఇంకా డీటైల్‌గా ఎక్స్‌ప్లైన్ చేయడం కోసం ఒక ఇమేజ్ అయితే జనరేట్ చేశాను. ఇప్పుడు మీరు ఇది పర్టికులర్ గేర్‌ని మీరు ఎప్పుడైతే ఫుట్ లెవల్‌ని మీరు అడ్జస్ట్ చేసుకుంటూ ఉంటారో, అంటే ఫస్ట్ మోడ్ సెకండ్ మోడ్ కింద అయితే చేంజ్ చేసినప్పుడల్లా మీరు ఇచ్చిన త్రాటిల్ ఏదైతే ఉంటుందో అది ఒక కంట్రోలర్‌కి వెళ్లి ఆ కంట్రోలర్‌లో అది ఏం అర్థం చేసుకుంటుందంటే ఇక్కడ మీరైతే కాలు దగ్గర ఉన్న ఫుట్ లెవల్‌లో మీరైతే చేంజెస్ మోడ్స్ పెట్టారో దానికి తగ్గట్టుగా టార్క్ అనేది అడ్జస్ట్ అవుతుందని చెప్తున్నారు. సో డిఫరెంట్ టార్క్స్ అనేది మీకు అయితే అందిస్తుందని చెప్తున్నారన్నమాట. ఇక్కడ గేర్స్‌, క్లచ్‌లు, ట్రాన్స్‌మిషన్ అయితే లేదు బట్ ఏంటంటే రియల్ బైక్‌కి ఎలక్ట్రిక్ ఒక టచ్ అయితే ఇస్తున్నారన్నమాట. ఉదాహరణకి మీరు ఫస్ట్ గేర్ ఆన్ చేస్తే మాక్సిమం టార్క్ అయితే లభిస్తుంది, సెకండ్ గేర్‌లో మరింత స్మూత్‌గా వెళ్తుంది, థర్డ్ గేర్‌లో బ్యాలెన్స్‌డ్ పవర్, ఫోర్త్ గేర్‌లో రిలాక్స్డ్ పెర్ఫార్మెన్స్, ఫిఫ్త్ గేర్‌లో హై స్పీడ్ ఫీల్ ఇలాంటి డిఫరెన్స్ చేంజ్ అయితే వస్తుంది. దీనికి వీళ్లొచ్చి 250 Newton-meter ఇన్‌స్టాంట్ వీల్ టార్క్ అనేది ఈ ఎలక్ట్రిక్ బైక్ యొక్క మోటర్ అనేది అయితే జనరేట్ చేస్తుందని చెప్తున్నారన్నమాట. సో దీనికి ఈ పర్టికులర్ ఓవరాల్ టెక్నాలజీకే వీళ్ళు ఇస్తున్న పేరు ఏంటంటే SYFT అనే ఒక షార్ట్ ఫామ్‌ని అయితే వీళ్ళు అయితే పిలుస్తున్నారన్నమాట. ఇక బైక్ ముందు భాగంలో చూసుకున్నట్లయితే మీకు ఇంటెలిజెంట్ అండ్ కనెక్టెడ్ ఫీచర్స్ అయితే ఉన్నాయి అని చెప్తున్నారు. కాల్స్ మరియు వాట్సాప్ సింక్ ఫీచర్స్ అయితే ఉన్నాయని చెప్తున్నారు, లైవ్ క్రికెట్ స్కోర్స్ ని కూడా మీరైతే చూసుకోవచ్చు అని చెప్తున్నారు. దీనితో పాటుగా స్మార్ట్ జియో ఫెన్సింగ్ ఆప్షన్ కూడా ఉంటుంది. అంటే మీరు బైక్‌ని పర్టికులర్ రేడియస్‌లో లాక్ చేసుకున్న తర్వాత ఎవరైనా బైక్‌ని మూవ్ చేస్తే మీకు అలర్ట్స్ అయితే వస్తాయన్నమాట. అలాంటి ఫీచర్ కూడా మీకు ఈ బైక్‌లో అయితే లభిస్తుంది. ఇక్కడ రేంజ్ రియల్ రేంజ్ ప్రిడిక్టర్ కూడా ఈ బైక్‌లో అయితే లభిస్తుంది, బ్యాటరీ పర్సంటేజ్ అయితే చూపిస్తుంది అన్నమాట. దాంతోపాటుగా బ్లూటూత్ సిగ్నల్ అలానే వైఫై సంబంధించి సిగ్నల్, మోటార్ ఆన్ ఆఫ్ సంబంధించి సిగ్నల్

title: 260 km Range- Avore Electric Bike Launch India - Mvs AutoTelugu
transcription: టైమరు, అలాగే డేట్, అలాగే మీకు సెట్టింగ్స్ ఇవన్నీ డీటెయిల్స్ కూడా మీకు ఇన్స్ట్రుమెంట్ క్లస్టర్ లో అయితే చూడొచ్చు అనమాట. ఇక్కడ 4G కనెక్టివిటీ ఇంటిగ్రేటెడ్ అనేది ఈ పర్టికులర్ బైక్ లో అయితే ఇస్తున్నట్లుగా చెప్తున్నారు. అలాగే బైకు ముందు భాగంలో చూసుకున్నట్లయితే ప్రొజెక్టర్ హెడ్ ల్యాంప్ అయితే లభిస్తుంది అనమాట. అలాగే వీళ్ళు యూస్ చేస్తుంది వచ్చి PMSM మోటార్ ని అయితే యూస్ చేస్తున్నారు. అలాగే అలాయ్ వీల్స్ కూడా ఈ పర్టికులర్ బైక్ లో అయితే లభిస్తుంది అనమాట. ముందు వెనుక కూడా డిస్క్ బ్రేక్స్ తో ఈ బైక్ అయితే లభిస్తుంది. ఇక ఇతర ఫీచర్స్ చూస్తే ఫాల్ ట్యాంపర్ అలర్ట్స్ అనమాట. ఇన్కేస్ మీ బైక్ కనుక కింద పడితే దానికి సంబంధించిన అలర్ట్స్ కానివ్వండి, క్రాష్ కి సంబంధించిన అలర్ట్స్ కూడా మీకు మొబైల్ కి అయితే సింక్ చేసుకోవచ్చు అనేది చెప్తున్నారు. వెహికల్ డయాగ్నోస్టిక్స్ మరియు TPMS ఫీచర్ కూడా ఈ బైక్ లో అయితే లభిస్తుంది అని చెప్తున్నారు. అలాగే ఫుల్ స్టాక్ నావిగేషన్, ఇంకా ట్రిప్ డేటా ను కూడా మీరు ఈ బైక్ కి సంబంధించిన ఇన్స్ట్రుమెంట్ క్లస్టర్ లో అయితే చెక్ చేసుకోవచ్చు అనేది చెప్తున్నారు. జియో ఫెన్సింగ్ గురించి మీకు ఆల్రెడీ చెప్పాను. అలాగే ఈ బైక్ లో మీకు మొబైల్ యాప్ కనెక్టివిటీ కూడా అయితే అందిస్తున్నారనమాట. సో AI కనెక్టివిటీ ఫీచర్స్ ద్వారా మీరు ఏమన్నా ఇన్ఫర్మేషన్ కావాలనుకుంటే మొబైల్ యాప్ ద్వారా కూడా మీరు మెసేజ్ అయితే చేయొచ్చు అని చెప్తున్నారు. అంటే మీకు మీ బైక్ లో ఉన్న స్టేట్ ఆఫ్ ఛార్జ్ కానివ్వండి, నా రైడింగ్ స్టైల్ ఏంటి అంటే ఈ బైక్ లో ఉన్న డేటా ఏదైతే ఉందో అనలైజ్ చేసుకుంటుందన్నమాట. మీరు ఇప్పటివరకు రైడ్ చేస్తున్న ఇన్ఫర్మేషన్ అంతా కూడా అనలైజ్ చేసుకొని మీకు సజెషన్స్ కూడా ఇస్తుంది అని చెప్పి వీళ్ళైతే హైలైట్ చేస్తున్నారు. ఇక ఇప్పుడు ఈ బైక్ లో మొత్తం మూడు వేరియంట్స్ ఇస్తున్నారు. బేస్ వేరియంట్ వచ్చి ఎవోర్ EX1 అనమాట, మిడ్ వేరియంట్ వచ్చి ఎవోర్ EX2, టాప్ వేరియంట్ వచ్చి ఎవోర్ EX 2S అనమాట. ఇందులో బేస్ వేరియంట్ వచ్చి మీకు 7.5 కిలోవాట్ల పీక్ పవర్ ఎలక్ట్రిక్ మోటార్ ని అయితే ఇస్తున్నారు. టాప్ స్పీడ్ వచ్చి 100 కిలోమీటర్లు ఉంటుంది. సున్నా నుండి 40 కిలోమీటర్ల వేగాన్ని వచ్చి 3.2 సెకండ్లలో రీచ్ అవుతుంది. IDC రేంజ్ వచ్చి 160 కిలోమీటర్ల వరకు క్లైమ్ చేస్తున్నారు, 3.24 కిలోవాట్ల బ్యాటరీ ప్యాక్ కెపాసిటీ తో అనమాట. ఇక ఇందులో మీకు రివర్స్, ఎకో, సిటీ, స్పోర్ట్ మోడ్స్ అనేవి అయితే ఉంటాయనమాట. ఇక ఈ బైక్ ని మీరు 20 టు 80% ఛార్జ్ చేయడానికి మూడు గంటల సమయం అయితే పడుతుందని చెప్తున్నారు. దీంతో మీకు 750 వాట్ ఛార్జర్ అయితే అందిస్తున్నామని చెప్తున్నారు, ఇందులో మీకు ఆన్ బోర్డ్ ఛార్జర్ అయితే లభిస్తుంది అనమాట. అలాగే బేస్ వేరియంట్లో మీకు వెహికల్ డయాగ్నోస్టిక్స్ సిస్టం కానివ్వండి, హాంకింగ్ మీటర్ వంటి ఫీచర్స్ అయితే ఉండవు అని చెప్తున్నారు. టచ్ స్క్రీన్ డిస్ప్లే అనేది కూడా బేస్ వేరియంట్లో లభించదు. డిస్ప్లే సైజ్ వచ్చి 7 ఇంచ్ ఎల్సిడి డిస్ప్లే అయితే లభిస్తుంది అనమాట. కాల్, ఎస్ఎంఎస్ వంటి అలర్ట్ ఫీచర్స్ బేస్ వేరియంట్లో అయితే లభించవన్నమాట. జిపిఎస్ అయితే లభిస్తుంది బట్ నావిగేషన్ అనేది బేస్ వేరియంట్లో అయితే అందించట్లేదు. సో బేస్ వేరియంట్ యొక్క ప్రైస్ వచ్చి ₹1,35,000, బట్ ఇంట్రడక్టరీ ప్రైస్ కింద మొదటి 10,000 యూనిట్స్ కి ₹1,25,000 కి ఈ బైక్ అయితే అందిస్తామని చెప్తున్నారు. ఇక రెండో వేరియంట్ వచ్చి

title: 260 km Range- Avore Electric Bike Launch India - Mvs AutoTelugu
transcription: ఎవర్ EX2 అన్నమాట. ఇందులో కూడా మీకు 7.5 kw ఎలక్ట్రిక్ మోటార్ ఏ ఉంటుంది. బట్ ఇందులో ఏంటంటే బ్యాటరీ ప్యాక్ కెపాసిటీ అయితే ఎక్కువగా ఉంటుందన్నమాట. 5 kw బ్యాటరీ ప్యాక్ కెపాసిటీ తో 255 km సర్టిఫైడ్ రేంజ్ అయితే క్లెయిమ్ చేస్తున్నారన్నమాట. ఇందులో మీకు ఛార్జర్ కూడా రేటింగ్ మారుతుంది, 1500 w ఛార్జర్ అయితే లభిస్తుంది అన్నమాట. ఈ బైక్ ని మీరు రెండు గంటల్లోనే 80% ఛార్జింగ్ అది చేసుకోవచ్చని చెప్తున్నారు. ఇందులో కూడా మీకు 7 ఇంచ్ డిజిటల్ ఎల్సీడీ డిస్ప్లే అనేది లభిస్తుంది. ఇక ఎవర్ EX2 వేరియంట్ చూసుకున్నట్లయితే, ఈ బైక్ ఒక ఎక్స్ షోరూమ్ ప్రైస్ ₹1,49,000 నుంచి అయితే స్టార్ట్ అవుతుంది అన్నమాట. ఇక మూడోది ఎవర్ EX2S. ఇది వచ్చేసి 10.5 kw పీక్ పవర్ ఎలక్ట్రిక్ మోటార్ ఉంటుంది. 114 km టాప్ స్పీడ్ అయితే క్లెయిమ్ చేస్తున్నారు. సున్నా నుండి 40 కిలోమీటర్ల వేగాన్ని 2.8 సెకన్లలోనే రీచ్ అవుతుంది అని చెప్తున్నారు. ఇందులో మీకు అడిషనల్ మోడ్స్ అనేవి యాడ్ అవుతాయి అన్నమాట. ఎకో, పాంప్ ప్లస్, సిటీ, స్పోర్ట్స్, అపెక్స్, SWS మోడ్స్ అనేది ఈ వేరియంట్ లో మాత్రమే లభిస్తుంది. ఇక చార్జర్ కూడా 1500 w ఛార్జర్ అయితే ఈ బైక్ లో కూడా అందిస్తున్నారు. బట్ ఇందులో మీకు అడిషనల్ ఫీచర్స్ వెహికల్ డయాగ్నోస్టిక్స్ సిస్టమ్ కానీవండి, టచ్ స్క్రీన్ డిస్ప్లే కానివ్వండి, కాల్ ఎస్ఎంఎస్ అలర్ట్ అలాగే జీపీఎస్ నావిగేషన్ ఈ టాప్ ఎండ్ వేరియంట్ లో మాత్రమే లభిస్తుంది అని చెప్తున్నారు. ఈ బైక్ ఒక ఎక్స్ షోరూమ్ ప్రైస్ ₹1,69,000 నుంచి అయితే స్టార్ట్ అవుతుంది అన్నమాట. ఈ ఎలక్ట్రిక్ బైక్ ప్రీ బుకింగ్ అమౌంట్ వచ్చేసి 799 అయితే మెన్షన్ Claude Cowork is generally available in the Claude Desktop app on macOS and Windows for Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise users. To get started, open Claude Desktop and click the Cowork tab. In a regular Claude chat, you work with Claude step-by-step. In Cowork, you hand off tasks, and Claude handles the rest while you focus on other work. First, give Claude access to a folder on your computer. Select the folder directory or project you want Claude to operate in. It asks permission before making changes to your file system. Claude can now read, create, and edit files in that folder directly. You can favorite the folders you go to most or select multiple folders to connect disparate data sources. Second, connect your tools. Cowork supports connectors that link Claude to services. These let Claude pull context from where your work already lives. Third, if you've set up Claude in Chrome, Cowork can use it for browser-based tasks, reading web pages, extracting data from sites, and navigating across tabs. Under settings, you can also click the Cowork tab and set global instructions that apply to every session, like context about your role or directions to create files as Word docs instead of markdowns. One thing to keep in mind, your Cowork sessions are stored locally on your device, and the Desktop app needs to stay open while Claude is working on a task. Let's start with something really simple.

वो कैसे? ऐसे। गंदा जोक था ये वाला। देखो, आपकी वॉइस का मतलब ये नहीं है कि आप क्या बता रहे हो, बल्कि ये है कि आप कैसे बता रहे हो। जैसे आज तक बहुत सारे लोग एडिटिंग को स्क्रीन पे बैठ के ट्यूटोरियल की तरह बोरिंग तरीके से समझाते थे। मैंने उसी कंटेंट को थोड़े फन, एंटरटेनिंग वे में प्रेजेंट किया और रिजल्ट आपके सामने है। चलो, मतलब जोक्स मारने हैं ना? সমস্ত হেডমাস্টার এবং অ্যাসিস্ট্যান্ট টিচারদের সিপিডি অর্থাৎ কন্টিনিউয়াস প্রফেশনাল ডেভেলপমেন্ট কোর্সগুলো মিনিমাম ৫০ ঘণ্টা করতে হবে। এর মধ্যে আমরা তো কেউ ৫০ ঘণ্টা, ৬০ ঘণ্টা, ৭০ ঘণ্টা করে ফেলেছি। কিন্তু সেগুলো সিপিডি কোর্স কি না সেটা আমাকে দেখতে হবে। সিপিডি কোর্সগুলো কিন্তু মিনিমাম ৫০ ঘণ্টা, বাকি যত কোর্স আছে আপনি ৭০, ৮০, ৯০ ঘণ্টাও অনেকে করে নিয়েছে শুনছি, কিন্তু করে নিতেই পারেন কোনো অসুবিধা নেই, যত বেশি করবেন তত আপনার স্কিল ডেভেলপমেন্ট হবে। তার সঙ্গে আর একটা গুরুত্বপূর্ণ যে খুব সম্ভবত ৯০% আমি যা দেখছি সারা ভারতবর্ষের সিচুয়েশন, টেট আমাদের দিতে হবে। তো যেহেতু টেট আমাদের দিতে হবে, এমন কোর্সগুলো সিপিডি কোর্সগুলো বেছে নেব যেগুলো আমাদের টেট দিতে সুবিধা হবে বা টেটের কিছু নলেজও গ্যাদার হবে, সেই বিষয়টাও আজকে আলোচনা করবো। যেমন ৫০ ঘণ্টা যেটা আছে সেটা হচ্ছে ম্যান্ডেটরি করা হয়েছে সিপিডি কোর্সের এবং এটা প্রতি বছর করতে হবে। এই বছর করে নিলাম মানে না, প্রতি বছর কোর্স পালটে দেবে তারা সেই অ্যাপস এর মধ্যে এবং সেই অ্যাপস এ গিয়ে আমাদের কোর্সগুলো করতে হবে এবং প্রতি বছর কী কী কোর্সগুলো দেওয়া হবে সেগুলো জানিয়ে দেওয়া হবে। এনরোলমেন্ট হওয়ার শেষ তারিখ হচ্ছে এবছর ৩১শে আগস্ট অর্থাৎ ২০২৬-২৭ শিক্ষাবর্ষের এনরোলমেন্টের শেষ তারিখ হচ্ছে ৩১শে আগস্টের মধ্যে কিন্তু এনরোলমেন্ট করে নিতে হবে। এবং অনেকগুলো কোর্স কিন্তু শেষ হয়ে যাবে ১৫ই সেপ্টেম্বর, কিছু কিছু কোর্স কিন্তু ৩১শে আগস্ট বা জুলাই মাসেও, এই ৩১শে জুলাইয়ের মধ্যেও কিন্তু কিছু কোর্স শেষ হয়ে যাচ্ছে। তাই তড়িঘড়ি করে কিন্তু আমাদের এই কোর্সগুলো করতে হবে এবং এই কোর্সগুলো আমরা করছি কিনা সমস্ত ডিআই, সরি ডিআই নয়, স্কুল ইন্সপেক্টর এসআই এবং এআইকে দায়িত্ব দেওয়া হয়েছে, তারা স্কুল ওয়াইজ মনিটারিং করবেন যে সমস্ত শিক্ষকরা এনরোলমেন্ট করলেন কিনা বা তারা কোর্সগুলো করলেন কিনা। তাই এবার কিন্তু আমাদেরকে এই কোর্সগুলো কিন্তু করতেই হবে। তো কীভাবে করবো, কীভাবে সিপিডি কোর্সগুলো বেছে নেব, সেই পুরো ব্যাপারটা আমি স্ক্রিনে দেখাবো, তাই ভিডিওটা চলুন দেখে নিন পুরো ব্যাপারটা। তো আমি আমার মোবাইল স্ক্রিনে চলে এসেছি। মোবাইল স্ক্রিনে এই যে দীক্ষা অ্যাপ, দীক্ষা কোর্সে যাবেন না, প্রথমে দীক্ষা অ্যাপে ক্লিক করবেন। এই যে দেখতে পাচ্ছেন, এখানটায় দীক্ষা অ্যাপে ক্লিক করার পর এখান থেকে আপনাকে নিয়ে যাবে ও দীক্ষা কোর্সে আপনাকে যেতে হবে। সেটা কীভাবে সেটাও আমি দেখিয়ে দিচ্ছি চলুন। আমরা দীক্ষা অ্যাপে চলে এসেছি।

title: Diksha CPD Courses for Primary and High School Teachers। Diksha Courses for Teachers।
transcription: ল্যামে এই যে নিচের দিকে লেখা আছে দেখুন দীক্ষা কোর্স এই জায়গাটায় আপনি ক্লিক করবেন। এই জায়গাটায় ক্লিক করলে কিন্তু আপনি দীক্ষা কোর্সে চলে যাবেন। দীক্ষা কোর্স অ্যাপটা খুলে গেছে। তো এখানে যে এক্সপ্লোর কোর্সেস লেখা আছে না এটা আপনার ফোনে কিন্তু নিচের দিকে দেখাবে। যেহেতু আমার স্ক্রিন রেকর্ডার অন আছে এবং আমি ফোনের মোডটাকে চেঞ্জ করে নিয়েছি, সেই জন্য এটা এরকম দেখাচ্ছে। তো এইখানে আপনি ক্লিক করবেন, এক্সপ্লোর কোর্সেসে। এই জায়গাটায় ক্লিক করলে কিন্তু আপনি চলে যাবেন। লে আপনাকে কিন্তু এরকম একটা এতে নেবে। এখানে আপনার ফোনে কিন্তু অন্যরকম দেখাবে। এইখানে আপনি দেখবেন ফিল্টার করতে হবে আপনাকে। দেখুন এখানে ফিল্টার করবেন এই এই জায়গাটায় দিলে আপনাকে এই যে ক্লাস দেওয়া আছে, ক্লাসে এই ক্লাস লেখা টায় এটা তে ক্লিক করলে আপনার বিভিন্ন ক্লাসের কোর্সগুলো বেরোবে এবং সেখানে লেখা আছে দেখুন সি পি ডি। সিপিডি এই জায়গাটায় কিন্তু ক্লিক করবেন। এখানে ক্লিক করে অ্যাপ্লাই ফিল্টার করে দেবেন দিলে সমস্ত সিপিডি কোর্সগুলো কোন কোন গুলো রয়েছে সেটা কিন্তু দেখাবে। যেমন দেখো, দেখানো হচ্ছে এখানে আইসিটিসি এসসিইআরটি হরিয়ানা, এটা হরিয়ানার ক্ষেত্রে। আচ্ছা পেডাগোগি লিডারশিপ ট্রেনিং প্রোগ্রাম, এটা হেডমাস্টারদের জন্য। তারপরে যে কোর্স গুলো দেখাচ্ছে দেখুন, প্রত্যেকটা কোর্স কিন্তু সমস্ত টিচারদের জন্য। এখানে নিচে লেখা আছে দেখবেন এই যে যেমন কোর্সটা দেখাচ্ছে রিফ্রেসার ট্রেনিং এখানে সিপিডি কিন্তু লেখা আছে এই নিচের দিকে এই জায়গাটায়। তার মানে এটা কিন্তু একটা সিপিডি কোর্স। তারপরের কোর্সটাও সেরকম দেখুন এম এস ফাউন্ডেশন লিটারেসি এটাও একটা সিপিডি কোর্স। নিউট্রিশন সার্ভে এটাও একটা সিপিডি কোর্স, এটা প্রাইমারি থেকে টুয়েলভ পর্যন্ত যেকোনো টিচাররা করতে পারবে। পার্সোনালাইজড এডাপ্টিভ লার্নিং পাল, এটাও সিপিডি কোর্স। এরকম পরপর জীবন কৌশল, এটা বাংলায় দেওয়া রয়েছে সিপিডি করে একচুয়ালি ওটা আসামি ভাষায় দেওয়া রয়েছে। এনহান্স টিচার স্কিল ফর স্টুডেন্ট ক্যারিয়ার, এটাও সিপিডি কোর্স। এরকম পরপর সিপিডি কোর্সগুলোকে আপনার কাছে কিন্তু নিয়ে যাবে। না হলে এক্সপ্লোর কোর্স করে পুরোটা সার্চ করতে থাকবেন। নিচে লেখা আছে সিপিডি কোর্স বলে এবং কোনটা কত ঘণ্টার সমস্ত ডিটেলসে আপনি পেয়ে যাবেন। যেমন ধরুন আমি এই এই প্রোগ্রামটা দেখতে চাইছি। এই প্রোগ্রামটা কোর্স ডেসক্রিপশনে গেলে এই যে কোর্স ডেসক্রিপশন সমস্ত ডেসক্রিপশন দেওয়া আছে। কোর্স ১০ ঘণ্টার কোর্স এটা কিন্তু ৩১শে জুলাইয়ের মধ্যে কিন্তু এই কোর্সটা শেষ হয়ে যাবে লেখাই আছে। এরকম কিছু কোর্স আছে ২০২৭ এর সেপ্টেম্বর পর্যন্ত আছে। কিছু কোর্স আছে নেই বেশিদিন, ৩১শে আগস্টের মধ্যে শেষ হয়ে যাচ্ছে। তো এইভাবে আমাদের সমস্ত কোর্সগুলো কিন্তু করে নিতে হবে যেগুলো সিপিডি কোর্স এগুলো কমপক্ষে ৫০ ঘণ্টা করতে হবে। ভিডিওটা ভালো লাগলে সবাইকে শেয়ার করে দেবেন। চ্যানেলে নতুন হলে চ্যানেলটা সাবস্ক্রাইব করে নেবেন। থ্যাংক ইউ ফর ওয়াচিং।

title: 🎓 How to Become a Company Secretary (CS) in 2026 | Complete Step-by-Step Guide | Neha Patel
transcription: अगर आप 2026 में सीएस बनना चाहते हो या फिर सीएस स्टार्ट कर रहे हो तो इस वीडियो को एंड तक देखना। सो यस गाइस आज के वीडियो में मैं आपको बताने वाली हूं कि सीएस आप कैसे बन सकते हो, सीएस के स्टेजेस के बारे में डिस्कस करेंगे, सीएस क्या होता है यह समझेंगे, ट्रेनिंग्स क्या होती है, सीएस आप कहां से कर सकते हो, कौन से रिसोर्सेज रिफर करने हैं, एवरीथिंग। यह 15 मिनट का जो वीडियो है वह आपका आगे आने वाला 50 साल पूरा डिस्कस कर लेगा, एक पूरी क्लैरिटी मैप आपको मिलने वाली है। सो यस फ्रेंड्स वेलकम बैक टू माय चैनल, दिस इज नेहा पटेल। मैं खुद एक कंपनी सेक्रेटरी और लॉयर हूं, मैंने सीएस क्लियर किया था इन द ईयर 2020 विद एन ऑल इंडिया रैंक इन ऑल द थ्री स्टेजेस एंड ट्रस्ट मी गाइस 2020 के बाद से सीएस काफी ज्यादा चेंज हुआ है एंड 2026 में तो काफी ही ज्यादा चेंज हो गया है सीएस, क्या चेंज हुआ है वह भी हम इस वीडियो में डिस्कस करेंगे तो चलो शुरू करते हैं। सो गाइस सबसे पहले मैं कुछ डाउट्स क्लियर करना चाहती हूं। बच्चों को यह डाउट आता है कि मैं साइंस बैकग्राउंड से हूं तो क्या मैं सीएस कर सकता हूं, कर सकती हूं? तो डेफिनेटली सीएस में कोई एंट्री बैरियर नहीं है, आप साइंस से हो, आर्ट्स से हो, कॉमर्स से हो, हर कोई सीएस कर सकता है। सेकंड, एलिजिबिलिटी जो है सीएस करने की वह होती है ट्वेल्थ, ठीक है? तो यहां पर दो तरीके से आप सीएस में आ सकते हो, नंबर वन इज की आप अपना ट्वेल्थ क्लियर करके सीएस में आ जाओ, सेकंड इस की आप ग्रेजुएशन करके सीएस में आओ। तो ट्वेल्थ की बात करें तो ट्वेल्थ के बाद आपको तीन स्टेजेस करने पड़ेंगे, पहला होता है सीएसइइटी जो कि आपका एंट्रेंस है, उसके बाद सीएस एग्जीक्यूटिव एंड देन सीएस प्रोफेशनल। अगर आप ग्रेजुएशन के बाद आना चाहते हो तो एंट्रेंस आपका एक्जेंप्ट हो जाता है, आप सीधा आपको डायरेक्ट एंट्री मिलती है एग्जीक्यूटिव में एंड देन प्रोफेशनल। मेरी पर्सनल रिकमेंडेशन यही होगी कि आप ट्वेल्थ के बाद से ही सीएस स्टार्ट कर लो अगर आप एकदम श्योर शॉर्ट क्लियर हो बिकॉज जब तक आप ग्रेजुएट होगे तब तक तो आप सीएस बन भी जाओगे, तीन ही साल का कोर्स होता है, दैट्स व्हाई। तो अभी हम बात करते हैं इसके पहले स्टेज की जो की है सीएसइइटी - सीएस एग्जीक्यूटिव एंट्रेंस एग्जाम टेस्ट। नाउ गाइस इसमें काफी ज्यादा चेंज आया है, अगर आप 2026 के पहले सीएस करने की सोच रहे थे ना, तो सीएसइइटी आप घर बैठे-बैठे एमसीक्यू में अपने कंप्यूटर में पास हो जाते, बट अभी आपको एक्चुअल में सेंटर्स में जाना पड़ेगा और आंसर लिखना पड़ेगा। एक्चुअल में तीन घंटे पेपर आपको देने हैं, चार सब्जेक्ट होता है एंड सेंटर में जाकर आपको पेपर देना होगा, बस एक ही पेपर है सीएसइइटी का जो कि अभी एमसीक्यू बेस्ड होगा वह है लॉ का पेपर, बाकी तीनों सब्जेक्ट्स आपको लिखने हैं तो यह सबसे बड़ा चेंज आपके एंट्रेंस लेवल पर ही आया है। जो सीएसइइटी है वो साल में तीन बार होने वाला है फेब में, जून में एंड अक्टूबर में।

title: 🎓 How to Become a Company Secretary (CS) in 2026 | Complete Step-by-Step Guide | Neha Patel
transcription: CSEET में टोटल चार सब्जेक्ट्स होते हैं जो कि मैं आपको स्क्रीन में दिखा देती हूं। एंड जैसे की मैंने आपको बताया की इसमें से स्टार्टिंग के तीन पेपर्स आपको लिखने हैं एंड लॉ का जो पेपर है वह आपका एमसीक्यू बेस्ड होगा। बट वह भी आपको सेंटर में जाकर करना है। CSEET ऐसा स्टेज है की जो आप एक्चुअल में खुद से पढ़कर भी क्लियर कर सकते हो। बट मैं रिकमेंड करूंगी की आप कोई कोचिंग या फिर यूट्यूब से लेक्चर्स देखो ताकि आपको इन डेप्थ सीएस की नॉलेज मिले, उसका करिकुलम पता चले, वे ऑफ़ आस्किंग क्वेश्चंस पता चले। एंड मेक श्योर करना कि आप इसमें राइटिंग प्रैक्टिस बहुत सारी करो तो आपके लिए CSEET क्लियर करना इजी हो जाएगा। जैसे ही आप CSEET क्लियर कर लेते हो, उसके बाद आपको एक ट्रेनिंग करनी पड़ती है जो की होती है थ्री डेज ओरिएंटेशन प्रोग्राम - टीडीओपी। यह आप आईसीएसआई वेबसाइट में जाकर अपने आप को रजिस्टर कर सकते हो और घर बैठे-बैठे भी टीडीओपी दे सकते हो या फिर अपने आसपास के कोई आईसीएसआई सेंटर में जाकर भी टीडीओपी दे सकते हो। जैसे ही सीएस एग्जीक्यूटिव में रजिस्टर करोगे उसके 30 डेज के अंदर आपको टीडीओपी खत्म करनी पड़ती है। नाउ सीएस एग्जीक्यूटिव इज वन ऑफ़ द टफेस्ट स्टेज ऑफ़ सीएस। CSEET क्लियर होने के बाद आप सीएस एग्जीक्यूटिव देते हो। एंड सीएस एग्जीक्यूटिव साल में दो बार होता है, जून में होता है एंड दिसंबर में होता है। एंड यहां पर दो ग्रुप्स होते हैं। ग्रुप वन में ये चार सब्जेक्ट्स हैं। ग्रुप टू में ये तीन सब्जेक्ट्स हैं। यह सातों के सातों सब्जेक्ट्स आपको राइटिंग में है। कुछ भी एमसीक्यू नहीं है। मेरे टाइम पर तीन पेपर्स एमसीक्यू हुआ करते थे एग्जीक्यूटिव में बट अभी इट्स कंपलीटली राइटिंग। आपके पास ऑप्शन है की आप कोई एक ग्रुप पहले, तो आप ग्रुप टू भी पहले दे सकते हो, ग्रुप वन भी दे सकते हो। या फिर आप दोनों ग्रुप एक साथ दे सकते हो। इट इस कंपलीटली अप टू यू। मैं रिकमेंड करूंगी की दोनों ग्रुप एक साथ दो, इसके काफी बेनिफिट्स होते हैं। ऑल इंडिया रैंक दोनों ग्रुप एक साथ देने पर ही आती है। आपको सेट ऑफ़ का बेनिफिट मिल जाता है की अगर एक ग्रुप में मार्क्स कम आए और दूसरे में ज्यादा, वो मार्क्स एडजस्ट हो जाते हैं। तो अगर आप एग्जीक्यूटिव क्लियर करना चाहते हो तो हर एक पेपर में आपको 40 परसेंटेज मार्क्स लाना पड़ेगा, दैट इस 100 में से 40। एंड ग्रुप वाइज देखा जाए तो एवरेज 50% आपको लाना पड़ेगा। जैसे ग्रुप वन में 400 में से 200 लाना पड़ेगा, ग्रुप टू में 300 में से 150 आपको लाने पड़ेंगे। तब जाकर आप एग्जीक्यूटिव क्लियर कर पाओगे। एंड यही सेम पासिंग परसेंटेज CSEET का भी है की इंडिविजुअल सब्जेक्ट्स 40 एंड एवरेज 50। यही सब में, प्रोफेशनल में भी यही है। दिस इस योर एग्जाम पासिंग परसेंटेज स्ट्रक्चर। नाउ गाइस, एग्जीक्यूटिव में यू हैव टू बी वैरी केयरफुल बिकॉज़ यहां पे जो लेवल ऑफ़ क्वेश्चंस आपसे पूछे जाते हैं वह कंपलीटली डिफरेंट होते हैं जो हम एक्चुअल में ट्वेल्थ में पढ़ते आए हैं। तो यहां पे आपको मेक श्योर करना है की आप पास्ट ईयर के क्वेश्चंस बहुत रेगुलर बेसिस पे सॉल्व कर रहे हो। आप राइटिंग प्रैक्टिस और टेस्ट काफी रेगुलर बेसिस पे दे रहे हो। आप लेक्चर्स डेली बेसिस पे देख रहे हो, बैकलॉग्स नहीं क्रिएट कर रहे हो और रिवीज़न कंसिस्टेंटली कर रहे हो। सेल्फ स्टडी पर भी अच्छा खासा टाइम इन्वेस्ट कर रहे हो। अगर आप डिटेल्ड एग्जीक्यूटिव की स्ट्रेटजी जानना चाहते हो तो मैंने काफी सारे वीडियोस बनाए हुए हैं प्लस ऑल इंडिया रैंक सीरीज जो की 30 डेज की है, वह भी मेरे यूट्यूब चैनल पर लाइव है। अगर आप ऑल इंडिया रैंक लाना चाहते हो तो वो सीरीज जरूर देखना, उसमें मैंने सारे

title: 🎓 How to Become a Company Secretary (CS) in 2026 | Complete Step-by-Step Guide | Neha Patel
transcription: meri strategies aur tips discuss ki hai with study routine. Ab agar aap CS executive clear kar jaate ho toh ye bohot hi badi baat hai bohot acchi baat hai. CS Executive clear karne ke baad aapke paas do option aata hai. Ek option toh ye aata hai ki aap apni training start kar do jo ki practical training hoti hai 21 months ki. Aapko actual me corporate ya fir firm me jaake isko karna hota hai. Toh ye option humari ICSI deti hai ki aap isko Executive ke baad bhi start kar sakte ho ya Professional ke baad bhi start kar sakte ho. Jab bhi start karo 21 months ki hoti hai. Toh ye yahan pe aapko option aata hai ki Executive ke baad aap training start karo ya toh aap Professional do. Mai recommend karungi ki training start kar do aur sath me Professional de do. For example agar aap June 26 me Executive clear karte ho toh aapke paas option aata hai June 27 me Professional ko appear karne ka, ek saal ka gap toh rehne hi wala hai, toh usme aap apni ek saal ki, 12 months ki training bhi khatam kar sakte ho, and ek group ke liye bhi prepare kar sakte ho Professional ka. Toh ye zyada strategically dekha jaye toh jaldi aapki training bhi khatam ho jayegi and fir aapka Professional bhi khatam ho jayega. Agar aapko training Executive ke baad nahi deni hai toh aap seedha ek saal ke baad Professional me dono group ke liye appear karna, tab jab aapka Professional clear ho jayega uske baad fir aap 21 months ki training start kar sakte ho, it is completely up to you. Ab jaise hi aap Professional me aate ho toh yahan pe bhi again do group hote hai. Group 1 me char subjects jo ki ye rahe, Group 2 me teen subjects jo ki ye rahe. Yahan pe jo do paper hai, wo elective hote hai. Now elective matlab ki aap dekh ke answer likh sakte ho, but that doesn't mean ki wo easy hone wala hai, bacche isi subject me fail hote hai, because kahi se bhi wo question aapko puch sakta hai. Toh Professional me jaise hi aap aaoge aapko actual me saara pata chal gaya hoga ki ICSI ka mindset kya hota hai, ICSI kis level ke questions puchta hai, kaise aapko writing karni hai, but elective aisa paper hai jisme bacche, you know, ghabra jaate hai aur bacche stuck ho jaate hai. Toh jaise hi Professional me aap aaoge you have to be very cautious of elective. Now, Professional bhi aap clear kar loge na fir bhi aap apne naam ke aage CS nahi laga paoge. Kyunki iske baad ek aur training hoti hai jo ki hai CLDP, Corporate Learning Development Program. Now ye training aapko karni padti hai jo ki actual me offline hoti hai, 30 days ki hi hoti hai, 15 days online, 15 days offline. Yahan pe aapko actual me center me jaake rehna hoga and wahan pe aapko sikhaya jayega kaafi, kaafi interesting cheeze, professionalism sikhayi jayegi, fir company law ke concepts ke baare me bhi aapko bataya jayega, and kaafi saare competitions hote hai, bohot hi maza aata hai. Mai toh bolungi ki aap sab ek baar residential CLDP ka experience lena. Jaise hi aapka CLDP training jo hoti hai, wo khatam hogi na, usi ke baad hi aapko convocation me bulaya jayega and aapko milegi CS ki degree and aap apne naam ke aage CS laga sakte ho.

title: How to think like a lawyer | Zero-L from Harvard Law School
transcription: Imagine I asked you, what do you learn in law school? Well, you've decided to take this course, so maybe you're more informed than the average person. So instead imagine I asked your college roommate or your parents, assuming they're not lawyers. The image that may come to mind of law school is sun-deprived, bespectacled law students surrounded by large numbers of dusty books, reading intently so they can memorize a bunch of law cases. And don't get me wrong, we do make students read a lot from books, and there's some memorization involved. But that image of someone learning the law by just memorizing things that are already out there is not at all what law school is really about. If it were, law school would be much less fun, and also much less useful. The law is always changing. So if you just learned a number of dry rules, much of what you learned might be outdated by your fifth year in practice. The chief value of legal education is not to know stuff, but to know what stuff to look for, where to find it, how to interpret what you find, what to think when some stuff says one thing, and other stuff says another. And how to use what you find to give legal advice. Let me put this very tangibly for you. If you call up a lawyer on anything other than a very simple question, and without pausing, she quickly gives you a straightforward answer, you should fire her. She's not doing a very good job for you. She's just not thinking like a lawyer. That's a phrase you'll hear a lot in law school, and while we might over-use it a bit, it does capture something important. Law is mostly about questions, choices, and analysis, about thinking and not so much about simple answers. That is the main thing we try to teach you in law school. Yes, we want to teach you a good amount of content about the law. To use an example from a course I teach, civil procedure, we want you to know what claims without subject matter jurisdiction can get jurisdiction by way of being joined to other claims through 28 U.S.C. 1367. If that sounds a bit intimidating at first, that's very normal, it is. But by the end of 1L fall, that knowledge will be at the tip of your brain, or at least somewhere in there.

title: How to think like a lawyer | Zero-L from Harvard Law School
transcription: But while this kind of content is important and useful, the main thing we're trying to teach you is a set of approaches, techniques, a disposition to dealing with real problems that will enable you to go out in the world and deal with any legal problem. Some of these may be problems related to courses you never took. Indeed, some may relate to legal issues that never existed when you went to law school. A lot of my work is on cutting-edge technologies, so I encounter these all the time, topics like in vitro fertilization and posthumous conception. So a key goal of law school is to make you into a legal Swiss Army knife, to have the tool for any problem you encounter, or at the very least to know where to find that tool. To be clear, that doesn't mean you're to become a hired gun. Instead, you're called upon and valued for your ability to exercise independent judgment on questions of law and on policy. Some of you will want to become trial lawyers. Others will want to go into public service. Others will want to become deal lawyers or go into business through law. Others still will want to work for advocacy organizations. Many of you will disagree about many legal questions, but law school will help you learn to disagree and to argue in ways that are more likely to convince others that you are right. Regardless, we want to enable you to give sound legal advice to your client, or perhaps, if you're engaging in cause lawyering, to figure out a legal strategy and find a client who might bring that case. As we will develop in a later segment, while there are many legal skills to learn, from oral advocacy to negotiation, from contract drafting to organizational design, there are five primary skills that every lawyer will need to bring to the table. First, digest the facts. Second, spot the relevant issue or issues. Third, determine the governing law. Fourth, apply the governing law to the facts to generate arguments and probabilistic assessments. And finally, work with the client to understand how the legal analysis fits in with the client's overall interests and goals. And this whole course is aimed at getting you started on mastering these skills.

title: Panel Discussion: Putting YOU into your Business Brand (life after "Corporate")
transcription:
Now, Susie, you mentioned that you've, you know, you've come from a different background. You worked in the corporate space, you worked in technology. Um, and you've had to shift from kind of that corporate mindset to a small business owner, someone who is now looking at corporate marketing to marketing your own brand, marketing yourself, marketing your small business. I'd love to know, like, what is one shift that you personally had to navigate making that transition? And what can you offer to other women in this room that are making that shift as well?

It was so hard. I don't know how many other folks left corporate and suddenly had to come out and start talking about themselves. So, I spent a lot of time on that messaging at my at my company. And it was the company's voice, it was the company's style, and it was the company's message. And it was great. I was good at it, right? It was awesome.

And then suddenly, the company wasn't there anymore. Social media was new when I was working in corporate. I never posted my own thoughts and feelings about the world because everything I said was going to reflect back on my company. How was how were they going to look at this, right? I was working for somebody else, it was their brand. I came out and suddenly said, "I am my brand. I can talk about anything I want to talk about because I am my brand." It was scarier than heck, I hated it, I didn't want to talk about myself, I didn't want to sell myself, I didn't want to market myself. It was really intimidating. And so, that was my biggest kind of hurdle as I came into this, right? I had to worry about my skills, I had those. I had to worry about my pricing, I figured that out. But talking about me and putting myself out there was a huge mental shift for me. And I wrote a blog post for the Sunnyvale Chamber of Commerce all about going my own experience going to get photos taken of myself and how terrifying it was and how important it was to get those photos to tell my story. And I was talking about it, I was using my voice, and it was great, and it felt good. And then I got to my about me, and I switched into, "Susie McFaddin is an internationally published award-winning photographer who blah blah blah." And the folks who reviewed it for me said, "That's great, but it didn't sound like you as soon as you started talking about yourself."

title: Panel Discussion: Putting YOU into your Business Brand (life after "Corporate")
transcription: Like that was the most boring about me I've ever read. So, I rewrote it. And I talked about me. I don't know if y'all remember this, but when Facebook and social media first started, we all had our profile photos that had somebody's weird hand on our shoulder because we cut somebody out of the photo. Because that's when we're our most natural. That's when we're comfortable, we feel great, we're with our friends, we're with our loved ones. And then come into a photo studio, and suddenly, like, you're an awkward adolescent again. What do I do with my hands? How do I sit? What kind of smile do I want? And that's where I come in. It's like, we talk, we chat, we do all of those wonderful things to talk about what your brand is. Some of my favorite brand photos of me, I'm in overalls. Shout out to the Jenny Wave ladies. I love overalls. I'm creating photos where my clients look their best, many of them are in suits, business wear, and I am running around in overalls, a tank top, and I'm barefoot, right? It's not about me. That's my brand. The big clunky glasses are my brand. My politics are my brand, right? I want people to know who they're coming to see, and that I offer a safe, inclusive space for them to get their, their photos taken, that that's a no judgment zone, right? All of those things that I couldn't do when I was corporate, are suddenly front and center to say, "This is who I am, and this is who you're going to work with." And, might I lose somebody who reads some of my, my values and politics and says, "Ooh." Great, bye-bye. Go with, go with grace. You will find somebody that you connect with more. And, that to me, is what is so much fun about being a small business and being a solopreneur, is embracing who you are, and I love working with my clients to put a face to that, so that when you go out and make your social media posts about you, and get all of that traction, and people saying, "This person is awesome, and oh, by the way, they also do this." title: This Week in Review | Fed Meeting, US GDP, Eurozone GDP (July 31, 2026)
transcription: Hello and welcome to This Week in Review. This is our weekly segment that's designed to highlight a few important developments that you might have missed this week, and we'll talk about what they mean for markets, and, most importantly, the potential impact for investors. To stay up to date with our latest market insights, subscribe to our YouTube channel or visit fisherinvestments.com. Now, let's review what happened this week. First, the Fed meeting. On Wednesday, the Federal Open Market Committee, or FOMC, voted to hold the interest rate steady at 3.5 to 3.75%. This was the fifth straight meeting without an interest rate change. It was also a split decision, and three members voted to hike rates by 25 basis points. Headlines quickly seized on the story of a divided Fed, but we wouldn't really read too much into that. Differing opinions among Fed officials tells us very little about what the committee will do next, and dissenting votes don't make a rate hike more or less likely in the meetings ahead. Some investors may also worry that Chairman Kevin Warsh's decision to step back from so-called forward guidance may make monetary policy harder to predict or less transparent. We see that differently. Central banks can, and often do, change their minds without notice based on changing economic data or fundamentals. So rather than trying to guess their next move, we think investors are better served by keeping their focus on the broader fundamentals driving markets. Central bank decisions are just one of many forces shaping the global economy and capital markets, and while we believe a rate hike would be a mistake, the talk today is of small hikes. And, really importantly, even a hike or two from here would leave policy rates within a range that this bull market has already successfully navigated. Additionally, when we look around the developed world, yield curves remain steep and healthy. For long-term investors, that's perspective worth holding on to.

title: This Week in Review | Fed Meeting, US GDP, Eurozone GDP (July 31, 2026)
transcription: Next, US GDP. On Thursday, the US Bureau of Economic Analysis released its official first estimate for US second quarter 2022 GDP. It came in at 1.5% annualized growth, which is a slowdown from what we saw in Q1, where we saw 2.1% annualized rate. But the report still shows moderate expansion that was driven largely by very resilient consumer spending. When data tends to fall in a moderate range, there may be plenty of opinions about whether it's truly positive or just good on paper. So with that in mind, we believe it's really critical for investors to remember this. Stocks are forward-looking. GDP is backward-looking. Stocks don't wait for economic data or what happened in the preceding quarter. Instead, they pre-price all widely known information and move in advance of the economy. So as the Ukraine war continues and some inflation remains elevated, slower economic growth may actually worry those who assume that you need robust GDP for strong stock market returns. However, history shows this isn't the case. The US stock market has often had very nice positive returns, even during periods of modest economic growth. In fact, fears about a slowing economy can actually be a positive for stocks because they set a lower bar for reality to surprise to the upside. Finally, Eurozone GDP. This Thursday, we got the first estimate of second-quarter GDP for the Eurozone. It grew at 1.8% annualized. That's a notable increase from the flat reading we saw in the first quarter, and it landed well above market expectations. Growth factors included strong business investment and a recovering industrial output. On a year-over-year country-by-country basis, Spain led the region with annual GDP growth of 2.7%. Spain was followed by the Netherlands at 1.3%, Italy at 1%, and Germany at 0.9%.

title: This Week in Review | Fed Meeting, US GDP, Eurozone GDP (July 31, 2026)
transcription: After the first quarter, which featured some pressures from the ongoing war in Iraq and a 13.2% drop in Ireland's GDP, expectations for GDP growth were low. That set the stage for Eurozone stocks to climb a wall of worry. We feel that that wall is still higher than the US's today, and just as in the US, stocks don't need a perfect economy. They just need reality to be better than feared. Some also worried that the European Central Bank, or ECB's, recent 25 basis point hike, which was in response to some rising inflation, could hinder growth and maybe apply some pressure to stocks. However, we believe what really matters here is the yield curve. So, despite the ECB's rate hike and expectations for additional hikes later this year, the Eurozone yield curve remains nicely positive, which has supported healthy loan growth. We think this should be a tailwind for Eurozone stocks going forward. So, while GDP growth across the pond might be a little slower, markets appear to be pricing in the region's adaptability to challenges. Renewed Iraq war-related volatility or tariff concerns are certainly potential headwinds for Q3, but there's also good reason to believe the Eurozone is actually primed to do better than feared and to continue supporting this global bull market. That's it for this week. Thanks for tuning into This Week in Review. If you're looking for more insights, don't miss our other series. It's called Three Things You Need to Know This Week. We release it every Monday. You can also visit fisherinvestments.com anytime for our latest thoughts on markets. Thanks again for joining, and don't forget to hit like and subscribe.

title: Clorox (CLX) Stock Analysis 2026 – Graphs, Risks, Opportunities & Valuation ✅
transcription: Clorox is a good example of a defensive consumer staples business that the market once priced for certainty, then sharply repriced when that certainty broke down. In the pandemic era, investors were willing to pay a premium for bleach, disinfecting and household staples because demand looked unusually strong and durable. In hindsight, that was one of the market's big mistakes. It capitalized peak demand as if it were normal demand. Then the opposite happened. The August 2023 cyberattack followed by ERP-related shipment disruption in fiscal 2024 reminded investors that even a boring staples company can suffer real operational volatility. But Clorox also had real successes. Fiscal 2024 gross margin rose to 43.8%, adjusted EPS reached $6.10, and operating cash flow climbed to $1.04 billion as cost savings and recovery actions took hold. Today the stock looks much less loved. Clorox is trading around $132.85 with a trailing PE of about 21.8x. Against management's fiscal 2025 adjusted EPS outlook of $6.55 to $6.80, the stock is trading at roughly 19 to 20x forward earnings. The quarterly dividend is $1.22 or $4.88 annualized, which puts the yield near 3.7% at the current price. For a company that historically often attracted a much richer multiple because of brand strength, resilience and dividend dependability, that is a meaningful derating. The market is no longer paying up for Clorox as a premium safe haven. It is pricing it more like a mature business that has to prove earnings quality again. The reason the multiple is compressed is not that the brands stopped mattering. It is that fiscal 2025 is messy. In Q1 FY25, net sales fell 15% to $1.39 billion, organic sales were down 15%, and gross margin slipped to 38.8% from 42.1%. Management kept full-year guidance, but said results were likely to land toward the lower end because earlier order fulfillment problems caused consumption and market share losses.

title: Clorox (CLX) Stock Analysis 2026 – Graphs, Risks, Opportunities & Valuation ✅
transcription: That is the key issue around the current price. Investors are asking whether this is a temporary transition year or evidence that Clorox has become a slower, less predictable earnings story. Looking forward, the valuation debate is becoming more interesting. On one hand, the Gojo acquisition, completed on April 1st, 2026, adds Purell, expands Clorox's health and hygiene exposure, supports its long-term 3% to 5% sales growth target, and is expected to bring at least $50 million of run-rate cost synergies, with EPS neutral in year one and accretive in year two. On the other hand, the deal is being funded primarily with debt, so the market will want proof that Clorox can integrate Gojo cleanly while stabilizing the legacy business. My view is that today's valuation already reflects a lot of disappointment. If management restores cleaner organic growth and shows that Gojo improves the quality of the portfolio, the stock can re-rate higher. But until that happens, Clorox will likely remain a "show-me" staples name rather than regain its old premium multiple. Let's go straight into the risks, because with Clorox, the question in 2026 is not whether consumers still need bleach, trash bags, cat litter, or water filters. The real question is whether the company can stabilize demand, protect margins, and execute cleanly while the business is going through operational change and portfolio expansion. The biggest risk is volume pressure. In fiscal Q2 2026, net sales fell 1%, household sales fell 6%, lifestyle sales fell 5%, and management said earlier order fulfillment issues led to consumption and market share losses that keep full-year expectations near the low end of guidance. Reuters also noted pressure from shoppers trading down to cheaper alternatives. The second major risk is execution around the ERP transition. Clorox has described fiscal 2026 as being distorted by inventory shipped ahead of consumption before the US ERP implementation. Management said that retailer inventory drawdown should create about a 7.5 point sales headwind this year and reduce EPS by about 90 cents. Even though the final US ERP phase was completed in January, that does not automatically remove the risk. These kinds of transitions can still create friction in forecasting, replenishment, retailer relationships, and on-shelf availability, and in a staples business, even short disruptions can hurt share.

title: Clorox (CLX) Stock Analysis 2026 – Graphs, Risks, Opportunities & Valuation ✅
transcription: Another major risk is margin pressure from costs and competition. In Q2, gross margin fell 60 basis points, mainly because of higher manufacturing and logistics costs. Clorox's 10-K is also very clear that lower priced private label products can pressure sales mix and profitability, while larger retailers can demand lower pricing, higher trade discounts, and more promotional support. That combination matters. If cost inflation stays stubborn while branded pricing power weakens, earnings can compress faster than investors expect. Then there is the added complexity from Gojo. Clorox is acquiring Gojo for $2.25 billion and plans to fund the deal primarily through debt. Management sees long-term strategic benefits, but the deal is expected to be neutral to adjusted EPS in year one, which means the near-term burden falls on execution. If the core business remains soft, a debt-funded acquisition can reduce flexibility. And investors should not forget cyber risk, either. Clorox's 2025 10-K says the August 2023 cyber attack materially affected the business, and the company remains regularly exposed to cyber threats and security breaches. Clorox's 2026 risks are less about brand relevance and more about stacked execution pressure. Softer branded demand, ERP-related disruption, margin volatility, retailer pressure, and a larger balance sheet commitment all hitting at the same time. Now the opportunity side, because with Clorox, the upside is not just about waiting for a defensive stock to bounce back. The real opportunity is that the company may be building a better business mix than the market is currently giving it credit for. In the short term, the biggest opportunity is simple. Reported results should look cleaner once the ERP distortion is behind the company. Management said the major drag on fiscal 2026 is transitory and tied to retailer inventory movements around the system change, while the final US ERP phase was successfully completed in January. That matters because when a temporary operational distortion rolls off, investors can start focusing again on the underlying business rather than noisy comparisons. Second, health and wellness looks like a real source of upside. In Q2, that segment still delivered sales growth, helped by strong professional products shipments, and management continues to position Clorox around health, hygiene, and well-being. That is important because this is already one of Clorox's stronger areas, and it gives the company a more attractive growth profile than a pure slow-growth household staples story. A third short-term lever is innovation.

title: Clorox (CLX) Stock Analysis 2026 – Graphs, Risks, Opportunities & Valuation ✅
transcription: Clorox highlighted multiple launches across the portfolio, including Clorox Pure, new Scentiva bleach offerings, Glad ForceFlex Max Strength LeakGuard bags, and new Burt's Bees products. For a staples company, that matters because better innovation can improve mix, support shelf space, and help the company earn better pricing without relying only on broad inflation. Longer term, the biggest upside is clearly Purell. Clorox completed the Gojo acquisition on April 1st, adding a category leader with nearly $800 million in annual sales, more than 80% of revenue tied to a broad B2B distributor network, and roughly 20 million installed soap and sanitizer dispensers that support recurring demand. Clorox also says the deal supports its long-term 3% to 5% sales growth target, should generate at least $50 million of run-rate cost synergies, and should become EPS accretive in year two. So the upside framework is clear: cleaner comparisons, stronger execution in health and wellness, innovation that improves the core business, and a bigger platform in professional and institutional hygiene. If Clorox delivers on that mix shift, the stock can gradually be valued less like a troubled staple and more like a higher quality health and hygiene compounder. Looking at analyst ratings, the message is pretty cautious. Clorox has zero strong buy ratings, only two buys, 14 holds, two sells, and one strong sell. So this is clearly not a stock the Street sees as a high conviction idea right now. What that tells us is that analysts still respect the business, but they are not ready to fully trust the earnings story. Clorox has strong brands, defensive categories, and a long history of cash generation, which is why the stock is not being treated like a broken company. But at the same time, the large number of hold ratings shows that most analysts want more proof before becoming more bullish. The market is likely waiting to see cleaner execution, more stable organic performance, and evidence that recent strategic moves actually improve the quality of the business over time. Until that happens, analysts seem to view Clorox as stable, but not especially exciting. Clorox is currently seen as a wait-for-proof stock, resilient enough to avoid broad bearishness, but not strong enough yet to inspire major conviction.

title: Navitas Semiconductor (NVTS) Q2 2026 Earnings Explained | Why the Market Misread the $0.95 EPS Loss
transcription: Navitas Semiconductor's second quarter 2026 earnings triggered a sharp market reaction, but the headline tells only part of the story. Investors focused on a reported GAAP loss of 95 cents per share, a result that appeared to miss expectations by roughly 22 times. At first glance, that looked alarming. However, a closer examination of the financial statements reveals a very different picture. The reported loss was driven almost entirely by a one-time non-cash accounting adjustment rather than a deterioration in the underlying business. Once that accounting impact is removed, the operational performance appears considerably stronger. The key comparison begins with two earnings figures. While GAAP earnings showed a loss of 95 cents per share, the non-GAAP loss was only 4 cents per share. At the same time, revenue exceeded expectations by approximately 7%. The difference between those two earnings figures was a $203 million, one-time, non-cash SPACC earn-out accounting charge tied to the company's 2021 SPACC transaction. This adjustment had no impact on cash flow or ongoing operations, and has now been fully recognized, meaning it will no longer affect future financial statements. Operationally, the quarter showed meaningful progress. Revenue reached $10.53 million, representing 22% sequential growth and finishing at the high end of management's guidance. Looking ahead, management projected another 28% increase in revenue during the third quarter. The operational loss also improved modestly, declining from $11.7 million in the previous quarter to $11.4 million. Viewed through that lens, the underlying business improved rather than weakened. Much of the market reaction reflected a comparison between a GAAP result and non-GAAP expectations, effectively comparing two different accounting measures. Once those figures are separated, the operating trend becomes much clearer. Understanding Navitas also requires understanding its position within AI infrastructure. While AI discussions often focus on GPUs and computing power, every AI data center ultimately depends on efficient power conversion.

title: Navitas Semiconductor (NVTS) Q2 2026 Earnings Explained | Why the Market Misread the $0.95 EPS Loss
transcription: Electricity must be converted multiple times before reaching processors, and traditional silicon becomes increasingly inefficient during those conversions. Navitas addresses that challenge through power semiconductors built on gallium nitride, or GaN, and silicon carbide, or SiC. Both materials provide higher efficiency and greater power density than conventional silicon. Rather than remaining focused on lower-margin consumer charging products, the company has shifted its strategy toward higher-margin AI infrastructure and industrial power applications. An important competitive advantage is that Navitas offers both GaN and SiC technologies, whereas many competitors specialize in only one material. The quality of recent growth can also be evaluated across several financial metrics. Revenue increased to $10.53 million, supported by stronger demand across high-power products. Non-GAAP gross margin expanded to 39.5%, improving by 0.5 percentage points sequentially, and 1 percentage point from the prior year, as product mix shifted toward higher-value applications. The balance sheet remains another notable strength. Navitas finished the quarter with $557 million in cash and cash equivalents, and no outstanding debt. During the quarter, the company also raised approximately $373 million through an equity offering priced at $21.89 per share. Management indicated those proceeds will support manufacturing capacity expansion and potential acquisitions. Inventory increased from $14.9 million to $19.5 million as the company intentionally accumulated TSMC wafer supply in preparation for anticipated AI-related demand. Perhaps the most significant strategic milestone during the quarter was management's announcement that the Navitas 2.0 transformation was completed one full quarter ahead of schedule. Historically, approximately 90% of company revenue came from legacy mobile and consumer applications, while only 10% originated from newer, high-power markets. By year-end, management projects high-power products and AI infrastructure will account for roughly one-third of total revenue, with legacy mobile becoming largely immaterial.

title: Navitas Semiconductor (NVTS) Q2 2026 Earnings Explained | Why the Market Misread the $0.95 EPS Loss
transcription: Supporting that transition, high-power segments are growing more than 50% year over year, while AI data center revenue expanded more than 50% quarter over quarter.

title: Navitas Semiconductor (NVTS) Q2 2026 Earnings Explained | Why the Market Misread the $0.95 EPS Loss
transcription: Third, the largest AI infrastructure opportunity remains closely tied to the industry's 800V deployment schedule. Finally, legal uncertainty has increased following patent lawsuits filed by Wolfspeed and Renesas shortly before earnings. Management dismissed those lawsuits as attempts to slow competitive momentum, arguing that established competitors often resort to litigation when market share comes under pressure. Regardless of that interpretation, the legal proceedings introduce additional uncertainty that investors will continue monitoring. Analysts also pressed management on several key topics. Questions regarding 800V deployment timelines received consistent and confident responses, with management reaffirming its 2027 outlook, despite reports of isolated project cancellations. Questions surrounding the Magnachip strategy were similarly addressed, with management explaining that the initiative is designed to secure dedicated 8-inch wafer capacity, rather than transition toward an IP licensing model. However, management declined to provide detailed breakdowns of revenue by high-performance computing, data centers, or the percentage of future revenue already backed by committed orders versus programs still undergoing qualification. While strategic direction was discussed openly, more granular financial visibility remained limited. Ultimately, the investment thesis continues to revolve around one central question: whether the industry's transition toward 800V AI infrastructure unfolds on schedule. If deployment progresses as expected, Navitas's dual GaN and SiC portfolio, combined with its $557 million cash position, could support continued expansion until operational break-even. title: The Highest-Paid Podcasters Of 2026
transcription:
Today on Forbes, the highest paid podcasters of 2026.

When Jay Shetty started his podcast, On Purpose, in 2019, he remembers people telling him he was too late. The medium was already saturated, they said, with little room for growth. And wasn't he really just a content creator?

Seven years later, the 38-year-old self-help guru hosts one of the most popular podcasts in the world, competing not only with the biggest TV, radio, and internet-native talk shows, but blurring the lines between them entirely. Just as many people watch his lengthy interviews with celebrities, including Michelle Obama and Matt Damon, on YouTube, as listen on the iHeartMedia Network. Distribution deals that Forbes estimates paid Shetty $21 million over the past 12 months.

And when those deals expired this year, Shetty landed a new kind of contract, in which the audio and video of his show will not only be distributed by Spotify, it will also stream on Netflix, with the two companies combining to pay him an estimated $100 million over the next 3 years. Shetty tells Forbes, quote, "When I started, video wasn't normal for a podcast. Now we have the four largest streamers bidding for the show. To see that kind of interest and enthusiasm was pretty amazing, for me and for the industry overall."

The impressive thing about mega-deals like Shetty's is that, unlike the makers of movies, TV, or other forms of entertainment, podcasters retain ownership of their shows' underlying IP, meaning networks and platforms are paying millions just to license it as a distributor and ad sales partner for a set number of years. That's one reason why premium streaming giants like Netflix, Hulu, and Tubi had largely ignored the industry's rise over the past decade, allowing YouTube to grow into the largest podcasting platform in the world.

But beginning in 2025, hoping to cut into YouTube's dominance over engagement time, the streamers have made a splashy entrance. Industry dealmakers say that after Netflix's initial $1 million to $2 million bids for top podcasts were roundly rejected, the streamer adopted a strategy similar to the one it used previously to capture market share in scripted television: overpaying to lure talent away from incumbent platforms. Offers of $10 million or more per year, on a one- or two-year trial term, eventually convinced marquee shows from Spotify, iHeart, and Barstool Sports to sign on. Goalhanger, a UK-based podcast network, reportedly landed $19 million from Netflix to stream just 40 episodes of its daily talk show, The Rest Is Football, during the World Cup. Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos said during the company's earnings call earlier this year, quote,

title: The Highest-Paid Podcasters Of 2026
transcription: We think about video podcasts like the modern talk show, but instead of having a single brand-defined show, you have hundreds of them. Yet podcasts are ascendant because of their inherent differences from traditional television. They are much cheaper to produce, can run year-round, and make the bulk of their money from host-read advertisements inserted into the audio and video recordings. For the highest-end shows, brands will pay premium prices for a trusted host's personal endorsement or to target their audience's specific demographic. Joe Rogan reigns as the world's highest-paid podcaster, earning an estimated $82 million this year by pairing deep listener trust with massive scale, releasing around 15 episodes per month, and attracting more than 80 million downloads and views, according to one data provider. In 2024, Spotify rewarded him with a new three-year contract that could reach $250 million. For most podcasters, landing a $100 million-plus deal like SmartLess's from one of the major networks, mainly Spotify, SiriusXM, or iHeart, is still the ultimate prize. Deals are paid out as a guaranteed advance with a revenue-sharing model in place for any additional profits generated above this break-even point. But competition between networks is what drives the guarantees above $30 million per year for a select handful of elite talent. At that rate, ad sales are unlikely to make back much profit for networks on the shows, if any. Still, networks justify their biggest deals in other ways, including subscriber acquisition, attracting blue-chip sponsors, and using talent as brand ambassadors. For example, Wondery's top podcasters, New Heights hosts Jason and Travis Kelce, who are number seven on our list with estimated earnings of $35 million, appeared on a panel for parent company Amazon at the Cannes Lions Festival in June. Talent, meanwhile, are using their mega-deals and IP control to create mini-networks of shows under their umbrella, such as Alex Cooper's Unwell at SiriusXM, or Charlamagne tha God's Black Effect Podcast Network at iHeart. Cooper, the host of the Call Her Daddy podcast, is number eight on our list with estimated earnings of $32 million. And Charlamagne, who hosts The Breakfast Club, is number 10, with estimated earnings of $27 million. For full coverage and to see the whole list released on Thursday, check out Matt Craig's piece on Forbes.com. This is Kieran Meadows from Forbes, thanks for tuning in.

title: Dow Chemical International Private Limited Vs Commissioner of State Tax
transcription: Good morning friends. Today, let us understand a very important case law: Dow Chemicals Internationals Private Limited versus the Commissioner of the State Tax. A very important judgment, which will help you to understand. This judgment has come by the Appellate Tribunal, Delhi. The the subject matter is foreign entity procurement service for the group companies taxable as imports, not intermediary services. Let us understand in detail. The appeals were dismissed and the first appellate authority order confirming the rejection of refund claim were upheld. The tribunal ruled that the procurement services received by the Indian entity from its foreign group companies are taxable as import of service under the reverse charge mechanism, rather than qualifying as an intermediary service, which would place the supply outside India. The key reason was the foreign entity provides core procurement services on its own account as an independent contractor, not merely ancillary facilitation services between the two principles. Let us understand the facts in the dispute. The impugned action: the Joint Commissioner of the State Tax Appeals confirmed the rejection of refund claim for the IGST paid under the reverse charge mechanism on the procurement services received from the Dow Europe GmbH for the period January 22 to June 22, totalling approximately Rupees 13 lakh, crores. The petitioner's argument, let us understand the petitioner's argument. The appellant argued that the

title: Dow Chemical International Private Limited Vs Commissioner of State Tax
transcription: Services provided by do Europe were in nature of intermediary services under the Section 2 Sub-section 13 of the IGST Act making the place of supply the location of suppliers, Switzerland under the Section 13 Sub-section 8 of the IGST Act and thus not liable to GST. They contended that after in initially paying the IGST under the mistake can impression they reversed the input tax credit and sought a refund. The core question flow was whether the procurement of service provided by do Europe, a Switzerland-based centralized procurement hub for the do group to do chemicals International Private Limited India qualifies as an intermediary services under Section 2 Sub-section 13 of the IGST Act thereby determining if the place of supply is in India, the import of the services or outside India, not liable to GST. The key findings: The tribunal considered the definition of intermediary services under the Section 2 Sub-section 13 of the IGST Act and clarification provided by the circular number 159/15/2021 GST dated 28th September 2021 along with various High Court judgment to determine the nature of service. Minimum three parties: While the arrangement involved three parties, appellant, do Europe, and foreign suppliers, satisfying one prerequest, the tribunal noted that do Europe and do India are subsidiaries of do Inc, the do group, with the do Europe functioning as the centralized procurement hub, providing a core service to the entire group.

పాటు కృనాల్ పాండ్యా కూడా బెస్ట్ బ్యాటింగ్ చేసి మ్యాచ్ నైతే ఈజీగా గెలిచారని చెప్పాలి అగైనెస్ట్ విరాట్ కోహ్లీ టీమ్. మరి ఆర్సీబీ బ్యాటింగ్ లైనప్ అండ్ ప్లేయర్స్ ఇలా ఉంటే, అండ్ బౌలర్స్ ఎలా ఉన్నారని చూసుకుంటే, మెయిన్ గా శ్రేయస్ శర్మ, భువనేశ్వర్ అండ్ అభిమన్యం అండ్ మంగేష్ యాదవ్. ఈ ఫోర్ బౌలర్స్ అయితే వేరే లెవెల్ బౌలింగ్ చేశారంట ఆర్సీబీ ఫస్ట్ ప్రాక్టీస్ మ్యాచ్ లో. మరి ఇందులో ఇంట్రెస్టింగ్ నేమ్స్ ఏమున్నాయని చూసుకుంటే, మంగేష్ యాదవ్. మంగేష్ యాదవ్ దగ్గరి నుంచి న్యూ బాల్ తో అండ్ డెత్ ఓవర్స్ లో అయితే యార్కర్స్ తో భయపెట్టించాడంట ప్రతి ఒక్క ఆర్సీబీ బ్యాటర్స్ ని. సో మరి తను డైరెక్ట్ గా ప్లేయింగ్ 11 లో చూస్తామంటే ఇదైతే 100% ఫిక్స్ అయిందని మేనేజ్మెంట్ నుంచి అయితే ఇన్ఫర్మేషన్స్ కూడా వస్తున్నాయి. సో యశ్ దయాల్ ప్లేస్ లో మంగేష్ యాదవ్ ఫస్ట్ మ్యాచ్ ఆడబోతున్నాడు అగైనెస్ట్ ఎస్ఆర్హెచ్. ఇంక మరి ఆర్సీబీ టీం ప్లేయింగ్ 11 ఎలా ఉండబోతుందో అని చూసుకున్నా, ఇందులో త్రీ చేంజెస్ అయితే పక్కాగా ఉండిపోతాయి, ఇదైతే కన్ఫర్మేషన్ వచ్చింది టీమ్ మేనేజ్మెంట్ నుంచే. ఇందులో డఫీ, మంగేష్ యాదవ్ అండ్ ఫిల్ సాల్ట్. వీళ్ళు ముగ్గురైతే ప్లేయింగ్ 11 లో మాక్సిమమ్ ఉండబోతున్నారు. సో దీన్ని బట్టి చూసుకుంటే జాకబ్ డఫీ కి అయితే ఫస్ట్ ప్లేయింగ్ 11 లో ఛాన్స్ వచ్చేదే లేదు. మరి ఈ త్రీ ప్లేయర్స్ తో మీ ప్లేయింగ్ 11 ఎలా ఉంటుందో కింద కామెంట్ చేయండి. ఇంకా మన సెకండ్ అండ్ ఇంపార్టెంట్ టాపిక్ విషయానికెళ్తే ఎస్ఆర్హెచ్ టీం ప్రాక్టీస్ మ్యాచ్ 2 ఎలా జరిగింది, అండ్ ఈ మ్యాచ్ వల్ల మన ఎస్ఆర్హెచ్ ప్లేయర్స్ కి అండ్ మన ఎస్ఆర్హెచ్ టీం కి మరి ఎలాంటి ఇంపార్టెంట్ పాయింట్స్ తెలుసుకున్నామో చూసుకుందాం. మెయిన్ గా ఈ వీడియోలో స్టార్టింగ్ లోనే నేనైతే ఒకటి చెప్పబోతున్నా. మనం మాట్లాడుకున్న లాస్ట్ ప్రాక్టీస్ మ్యాచ్ 1 లో నేనైతే శివంగ కుమార్ గురించి అయితే మెన్షన్ చేయలే. సో దాని గురించి ఆ వీడియోలో అయితే మోర్ దెన్ 30 ప్లస్ కామెంట్స్ వచ్చాయి మావ, శివంగ కుమార్ గురించి ఎందుకు చెప్పలే అని. మెయిన్ గా తన గురించి ఫుల్ డిటైల్డ్ వీడియో ఒకటి చేద్దాం అనుకున్నా అందుకే తన గురించి ఆ వీడియో లో మెన్షన్ చేయలే. బట్ ఈ వీడియోలో నేనైతే తన గురించి ఫుల్ క్లారిటీ అయితే ఇచ్చేస్తా. మనం చాలా వీడియోస్ నుంచి అయితే చాలాసార్లు చెప్పుకున్నాం. శివంగ కుమార్ వన్ ఆఫ్ ది బెస్ట్ బౌలర్ అండ్ బెస్ట్ ఆల్ రౌండర్ అవ్వబోతున్నాడు ఎస్ఆర్హెచ్ టీం కి ఈ సీజన్ లో. సో ఎందుకంటే తన బౌలింగ్ యాక్షన్ చూసుకున్నా సేమ్ టు సేమ్ నూర్ అహ్మద్ లెక్కనే ఉంటుంది. ఇండియాలో కుల్దీప్ యాదవ్, సిఎస్కె టీం లో నూర్ అహ్మద్ అండ్ ఎస్ఆర్హెచ్ టీం కి శివంగ కుమార్. సో వీళ్ళు ముగ్గురు టాప్ క్లాస్ బౌలర్స్ ఉన్నారు ఎందుకంటే వాళ్ళ యాక్షన్ తో అండ్ వాళ్ళ అక్యురెసీ తో. మెయిన్ గా శివంగ కుమార్ అయితే లెఫ్ట్ హ్యాండర్స్ కి చాలా డేంజరస్ గా మారిపోతున్నాడు. తను వేసిన బాల్ ఎప్పుడైతే లోపలికి వెళ్తుందో చాలా కష్టంగా ఉంటుంది ప్రతి ఒక్క బ్యాటర్స్ కి. బట్ రైట్ హ్యాండర్స్ కి అంతే ఎఫెక్టివ్ గా ఉంటుందని నాకైతే డౌట్ ఉండేది. బట్ ఈ టూ ప్రాక్టీస్ మ్యాచెస్ వల్ల ఒకటి అయితే క్లియర్ అయిపోయింది. తనైతే ఎస్ఆర్హెచ్ ప్లేయింగ్ 11 లో బెస్ట్ అండ్ ఇంపార్టెంట్ ప్లేయర్ గా మారిపోయాడని నాకైతే అర్థమైపోయింది. సో మాక్సిమం అర్షద్ డూబే కూడా చాలా ఇంపార్టెంట్ స్పెల్స్ చేశారు కాబట్టి, శివంగ కుమార్ అండ్ అర్షద్ డూబే వీళ్ళిద్దరినీ ఫస్ట్ మ్యాచ్ లో చూసే ఛాన్సెస్ కూడా ఉన్నాయి. అండ్ మెయిన్ గా శివంగ కుమార్ దగ్గర నుంచి ఎంత బౌలింగ్ పొగుడుతున్నామో, తన బ్యాటింగ్ కూడా అలానే ఉంటుంది మావ, అదైతే పక్కా. ఈ ప్రాక్టీస్ మ్యాచ్ లో అయితే...

title: SRH & RCB Practice Match Full Highlights| RCB Practice Match-1| SRH Team Updates| #srh #rcb #ipl
transcription: బ్యాటింగ్ ని మనం చూద్దాం. బట్ చాలా డొమెస్టిక్ మ్యాచెస్ లో వచ్చి చాలా మ్యాచెస్ ని ఫినిష్ చేశాడని చెప్పొచ్చు. సో మ్యాక్సిమం తననైతే ఫస్ట్ మ్యాచ్ లో ప్లేయింగ్ లెవెల్లో ఉండే ఛాన్సెస్ ఎక్కువగా ఉన్నాయి. ఇంకా ఫస్ట్ గా ఎస్ఆర్ హెచ్ ఫ్యాన్స్ అందరికీ ఒక గుడ్ న్యూస్ అని చెప్పాలి. ఆల్రెడీ మనం రీసెంట్ గా మాట్లాడుకున్నట్టే ఇషాన్ మలింగ కి ఈ మండే శ్రీలంక టీం నుంచి ఫిట్నెస్ టెస్ట్ ఉందని మనం మాట్లాడుకున్నాం. సో తనైతే ఈ టెస్ట్ ని అయితే సక్సెస్ ఫుల్ గా కంప్లీట్ చేసాడు. అండ్ శ్రీలంక బోర్డు కూడా తనకైతే ఎన్వోసి ఇచ్చేసింది. సో ఇంకా నెక్స్ట్ టూ త్రీ డేస్ లో తనైతే టీం లో జాయిన్ అవ్వబోతున్నాడు విత్ కమెండో మెండీస్. అండ్ తనైతే లాస్ట్ వన్ మంత్ నుంచి ఫుల్ రెస్టెడ్ గా ఉన్నాడు కాబట్టి తనకైతే నెక్స్ట్ టూ త్రీ మ్యాచెస్ తర్వాత ప్లేయింగ్ లెవెల్ కాంబినేషన్ చూసుకొని లివింగ్స్టన్ పర్ఫార్మెన్స్ ఇస్తే తనకైతే ప్లేయింగ్ లెవెల్ లో అప్పుడే ఛాన్స్ దొరుకుతుందని నేనైతే అనుకుంటున్నా. తను టీం లో ఉండాలా లేదంటే లివింగ్స్టన్ కి ఛాన్సెస్ ఇవ్వాలా అనేది కామెంట్ చేయండి. ఇంకా ఈ సెకండ్ ప్రాక్టీస్ మ్యాచ్ లో అప్డేట్స్ విషయానికి వస్తే మెయిన్ గా మనం ఫస్ట్ ప్రాక్టీస్ మ్యాచ్ ఫుల్ ఆఫ్ రన్స్ అయితే చూసాం. బట్ సెకండ్ మ్యాచ్ లో అలా కాదు. మన టీం బౌలర్స్ అయితే వేరే లెవెల్ బౌలింగ్ వేశారని చెప్పాలి. ఫస్ట్ మ్యాచ్ బ్యాటింగ్ కి అయితే సెకండ్ మ్యాచ్ బౌలింగ్ కి అనుకూలంగా ఉన్నట్టు అయితే తయారు చేశారు అని చెప్పాలి పిచ్ ని కూడా. మెయిన్ గా ఈ ప్రాక్టీస్ మ్యాచ్ టూ లో కూడా నాకైతే ఇంట్రెస్టింగ్ అనిపించిన నేమ్స్ నితీష్ కుమార్ రెడ్డి, సలీల్ అరోరా, శివమ్ కుమార్, సకీబ్ హుస్సేన్. ఈ ఫోర్ ప్లేయర్స్ అయితే వేరే లెవెల్ ఫామ్ లో ఉన్నారని చెప్పుకోవచ్చు. మెయిన్ గా సకీబ్ హుస్సేన్ కూడా ఇంపార్టెంట్ స్పెల్స్ చేశాడని చెప్పాలి ఈ రోజు కూడా. ఫస్ట్ లెవెల్ లో పెట్టుకున్న నేనైతే ఆశ్చర్యపడాల్సిన అవసరం లేదు. ఇంకా ఈ సెకండ్ మ్యాచ్ లో బ్యాటింగ్ లో నితీష్ కుమార్ రెడ్డి 40 బాల్స్ లో 73 రన్స్, స్మరణ్ రావుచంద్రన్ 14 బాల్స్ లో 26 రన్స్, సలీల్ అరోరా లాస్ట్ उसके बाद हमसे यह पूछा गया था कि भाई मेजर जुडिशियल अपडेट्स बता दो कोई, है ना? मतलब कोई अपडेट्स वगैरा के ऊपर क्वेश्चन थे। एडवोकेट जनरल ऑफ यूपी कौन है? ठीक है? नए सीजीआई जो फर्स्ट वुमन सीजीआई होने वाली है, वह कौन है? उनका नाम क्या है? यह सारी बातें आपसे पूछी गई थी और कोर लीगल में बात करें तो फंडामेंटल लॉ क्वेश्चंस कवरिंग वॉइड कॉन्ट्रैक्ट्स थे, फेडरल स्ट्रक्चर था, ठीक है? बेसिक स्ट्रक्चर डॉक्ट्रिन था हमारे पास, तो यह मेजर पार्ट था हमारा लीगल का। वहीं पे अगर देखो यार स्टैटिक जीके और साइंस की बात करोगे, तो मतलब जो जीएस जीके वाला पार्ट होता है हमारे पास, वहां पे मेडिएवल और एंशिएंट सिटी फाउंडर्स का नाम पूछा गया था। ठीक है? हु बिल्ट व्हिच सिटी काइंड ऑफ क्वेश्चन पूछा गया था। जियोग्राफी में काफी फेक्चुअल क्वेश्चंस थे जैसे कि नेटिव ट्राइब बता दो कलहरी डिस्ट्रिक्ट का कलहरी डेजर्ट का। ठीक है? उसके बाद साइंस में कांसेप्चुअल क्वेश्चन थे, फाउंडेशनल क्वेश्चन थे। बेसिकली क्लास एइथ क्लास एइथ लेवल या फिर क्लास नाइंथ टू नाइंथ एंड टेंथ लेवल का था। बहुत बेसिक क्वेश्चन थे जैसे प्रेशर कुकर किस सिद्धांत पर काम करता है। यह वाली बात पूछी गई थी हमसे। फिर मिसलेनियस क्वेश्चन भी थे जैसे कल्चरल और मीडिया अह एकॉलेट्स थे हमारे पास, ठीक है? उसके बाद साहित्य अकादमी अवार्ड थे। वह जो हर बार ही सवाल आते हैं उससे, ठीक है? और यह एलएलबी एग्जाम्स के लिए बहुत ज्यादा इंपॉर्टेंट होता है। उसके बाद पुणे इंटरनेशनल फिल्म फेस्टिवल से भी सवाल थे। तो यह सारे सवाल इंपॉर्टेंट बनते हैं। अगर तुम ओवरऑल पेपर देखोगे तो ओवरऑल पेपर हमारा मॉडरेट था। ओवरऑल पेपर हमारा मॉडरेट था जिसके अंदर आपको फेक्चुअल क्वेश्चन डायरेक्टली पूछा गया है। वरना पी चीजें मतलब ऐसा नहीं है कि तुम्हें बहुत

title: AU 3 Year LLB 2026 Paper Analysis | Complete Question Paper, Difficulty Level & Expected Cutoff
transcription: कांसेप्ट के पीछे भागने की जरूरत है, ठीक है? हालांकि कॉन्सेप्ट नहीं आएंगे तो बेसिक क्वेश्चन भी नहीं कर पाओगे, बट फेक्चुअल नॉलेज भी होना बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी है। अगर तुम पूरे पेपर को ओवरआल देखोगे तो। तो मेरे हिसाब से जो कटऑफ है वो लास्ट ईयर जैसा ही रहेगा, ज्यादा कुछ डिफरेंस नहीं आने वाला कटऑफ में। कटऑफ के ऊपर मैं एक अलग से वीडियो लेकर आ जाऊंगा, हां जिन बच्चों को पेपर देखना है, ये मेमोरी बेस्ड पेपर है जो कि मैंने कम्पाइल किया है तुम्हारे लिए, ठीक है? तो इस मेमोरी बेस्ड पेपर पे, तुम जाके देख सकते हो, ठीक है? इसमें मैंने, अ जैसे इसमें इंग्लिश का है, तो इंग्लिश में क्या-क्या पूछा था? इडियम था जैसे 'प्ले डाउन करना', उसके बाद अपोजिट था। प्रोफ्लीगेट, प्रोफ्लीगेट का हमारे पास अपोजिट था, ठीक है? ऐसे आर्टिकल्स वगैरह के कुछ क्वेश्चन थे, वन वर्ड सब्स्टिटूशन के क्वेश्चन थे हमारे पास, ठीक है? तीन-चार ऑथर्स के ऊपर क्वेश्चन थे हमारे पास, है ना? तो काफी सारे क्वेश्चन थे। ये सारे मैंने पीडीऍफ़ बना दी है, ये कहाँ मिलेगी? ये इस टेलीग्राम चैनल पे मिलेगी, इसको तुम स्कैन कर सकते हो। बाकी मैं तुम्हें यही टेलीग्राम चैनल यहाँ पे भी दिखा देता हूँ। ठीक है? ये रहा टेलीग्राम चैनल। जो बच्चे 2027 इलाहाबाद यूनिवर्सिटी के लिए प्रिपेयर कर रहे हैं या CUET PG के लिए तैयारी कर रहे हैं उन बच्चों के लिए मैं एक इंपॉर्टेंट बात बता देता हूँ, दैट अभी हमारे बैचेस नए-नए स्टार्ट हुए हैं जिन बैचेस के अंदर आप एनरोल कर सकते हो और मैं एक इंपॉर्टेंट बात, अगर सच बात बताऊँ तुमसे, ठीक है? तो यार जिस हिसाब का कॉम्पिटिशन है, उसमें अगर तुम्हें बाकी बच्चों से लीड लेनी है, तो एक ही तरीका है कि तुम किसी कोर्स में एनरोल्ड हो। जिस कोर्स में आपको टॉपर्स जिस कोर्स ने प्रोडूस कर रखे हैं पहले, जिस फैकल्टी ने टॉपर्स प्रोडूस कर रखे हैं। और उसका स्टडी मटेरियल जो है, वो टू द पॉइंट एक्यूरेट है, आपको फ़ालतू की चीजें इधर-उधर की चीजें नहीं पढ़ाई जा रहीं। जो चीजें पेपर में आती हैं, वही चीजें पढ़ाई गई हैं। अब पूरे यूट्यूब पे जाकर देखो, आपको कहीं पे भी ये पेपर नहीं मिलने वाला। चलो, तो मैं यहाँ पे आपको लेकर चलता हूँ Adda247 पे, आल कोर्सेज, अब ये वीडियो जाने के बाद पेपर मिल जाए, तो वो अलग बात है, ठीक है? यूजी एंड पीजी पे जाओ, लॉ एंट्रेंस एग्जाम पे जाओ, और यहीं पे तुम्हें दिखेगा, सारे एग्जाम्स हैं, अगर तुम इलाहाबाद यूनिवर्सिटी की प्रिपरेशन कर रहे हो तो ये AU LLB पे क्लिक करके तुम ये देख सकते हो, ये थ्री इयर एलएलबी बैच है, अर्जुना बैच नाम है इसका, ठीक है? तो इस बैच के अंदर तुम एनरोल कर सकते हो, ये प्राइस मत पे कर देना गलती से, ठीक है? तुम कभी भी एनरोल करो, यूज़ द कोड Atul40, मैक्सिमम डिस्काउंट के साथ-साथ मेरी पर्सनल मेंटॉरशिप भी मिलेगी। अगर कोई परेशानी या दिक्कत हो तो, दिस इस माय मेल आईडी गाइस, ठीक है? पेपर तुम्हें यहाँ मिल जाएगा, पेपर मैं तुम्हें यहाँ भेज दूँगा, इस टेलीग्राम चैनल को ज्वाइन कर लो, हालांकि जब मैं ये वीडियो को रिकॉर्ड कर रहा हूँ तो टेलीग्राम बैन कर रखा है सरकार ने REET के चक्कर में, ठीक है? बट दो-तीन दिन में टेलीग्राम ऑन हो जाएगा तो वहाँ पे तुम्हें ये पेपर मिल जाएगा। ठीक है? सो या, दैट्स आल फॉर दिस वीडियो, थैंक यू सो मच गाइस फॉर बीइंग सच अ वंडरफुल ऑडियंस, मिलते हैं अगले वीडियो, अगले सेक्शन, अगले सेशन के अंदर, अंटिल देन कीप ग्राइंडिंग, कीप हसलिंग, जय हिन्द, बाय-बाय एंड टेक केयर।

title: JRC Quiz 2026 | JRC Questions and Answers 2026 in Malayalam | JRC Selection Test Questions 2026
transcription: ഹായ് ഫ്രണ്ട്സ്, എല്ലാവർക്കും നമ്മുടെ പുതിയൊരു വീഡിയോയിലേക്ക് സ്വാഗതം. നമ്മളിന്ന് നോക്കാൻ പോകുന്നത് ജെ.ആർ.സി.-യുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട ചോദ്യങ്ങളാണ്. അപ്പോ ജെ.ആർ.സി. എക്സാമിന് ചോദിക്കാൻ സാധ്യതയുള്ള കുറച്ചു പ്രധാനപ്പെട്ട അടിസ്ഥാന വിവരങ്ങളാണ് ഈ ഒരു വീഡിയോയിലൂടെ നമ്മൾ നോക്കുന്നത്. അപ്പൊ എല്ലാവരും വീഡിയോ മുഴുവനായിട്ടും കാണുക. നിങ്ങൾക്കായി ഒരു സ്പെഷ്യൽ ക്വസ്റ്റ്യൻ അവസാനം കാത്തിരിപ്പുണ്ട്. ആ ക്വസ്റ്റ്യന്റെ ഉത്തരം അറ്റൻഡ് ചെയ്യുകയും ചെയ്യുക. അപ്പോ ആദ്യമായിട്ടാണ് ഈയൊരു ചാനൽ നിങ്ങൾ കാണുന്നതെങ്കിൽ പെട്ടെന്ന് തന്നെ ഒന്ന് സബ്സ്ക്രൈബ് ചെയ്തു വെച്ചോളൂ. നിങ്ങൾക്ക് യൂസ്ഫുൾ ആയിട്ടുള്ള ഒരുപാട് വീഡിയോസ് ലഭിക്കുന്നതായിരിക്കും. അപ്പോ നിങ്ങൾക്ക് ഇനി ഏത് വീഡിയോയാണ് വേണ്ടത് എന്നുള്ളത് കമൻറ് ചെയ്യാൻ മറക്കരുത് കേട്ടോ. അപ്പോ നമുക്ക് പെട്ടെന്ന് തന്നെ ഓരോ ചോദ്യങ്ങളായിട്ട് നോക്കാം. ആദ്യത്തെ ചോദ്യം ഇതാണ്. ജെ.ആർ.സി.-യുടെ പൂർണ്ണരൂപം എന്താണ്? ജെ.ആർ.സി.-യുടെ പൂർണ്ണരൂപം എന്താണ്? ഉത്തരം, ജൂനിയർ റെഡ് ക്രോസ്. ജെ.ആർ.സി. എന്നാൽ എന്താണ്? ജൂനിയർ റെഡ് ക്രോസ് എന്നാണ് ജെ.ആർ.സി.-യുടെ പൂർണ്ണരൂപം. അടുത്ത ചോദ്യം, റെഡ് ക്രോസ് സംഘടനയുടെ സ്ഥാപകൻ ആര്? റെഡ് ക്രോസ് സംഘടനയുടെ സ്ഥാപകൻ ആരാണ്? ഉത്തരം വരുന്നത്, ജീൻ ഹെൻറി ഡ്യൂനന്റ്. ജീൻ ഹെൻറി ഡ്യൂനന്റ് എന്നാണ് ജെ.ആർ.സി. സംഘടനയുടെ സ്ഥാപകന്റെ പേര്. മറന്നുപോകരുത്, പ്രധാനപ്പെട്ടതാണ്. ജീൻ ഹെൻറി ഡ്യൂനന്റ് ആണ് ജെ.ആർ.സി. സംഘടന സ്ഥാപിച്ചത്. അടുത്ത ചോദ്യം, ഹെൻറി ഡ്യൂനന്റ് ജനിച്ചത് എപ്പോഴാണ്? ഹെൻറി ഡ്യൂനന്റ് ജനിച്ചത് എപ്പോഴാണ്? അപ്പോ, 1828 മെയ് 8-നാണ് ഹെൻറി ഡ്യൂനന്റ് ജനിച്ചത്. ജനീവയിലാണ് അദ്ദേഹം ജനിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നത്. ഏതാണ് വർഷം? 1828 മെയ് 8-ന് ജനീവയിൽ ജനിച്ചു. അടുത്ത ചോദ്യത്തിലേക്ക് കടക്കാം. ലോക റെഡ് ക്രോസ് ദിനം എന്നാണ് ആചരിക്കുന്നത്? ലോക റെഡ് ക്രോസ് ദിനം എന്നാണ് ആചരിക്കുന്നത്? ഉത്തരം, മെയ് 8. അപ്പോ നമ്മൾ പറഞ്ഞു ഹെൻറി ഡ്യൂനന്റ് ജനിച്ചത് 1828 മെയ് 8-നാണ്. അപ്പൊ അദ്ദേഹത്തിൻറെ ജന്മദിനമാണ് ലോക റെഡ് ക്രോസ് ദിനമായി ആചരിക്കുന്നത്. ഏതാണ് ദിവസം? മെയ് 8. മെയ് 8-നാണ് ലോക റെഡ് ക്രോസ് ദിനം. അടുത്ത ചോദ്യത്തിലേക്ക് കടക്കുന്നു.

transcription: ജീൻ ഹെൻറി ഡ്യൂനന്റിനെ റെഡ് ക്രോസ് സ്ഥാപിക്കാൻ പ്രേരിപ്പിച്ച യുദ്ധം ഏതാണ്? ചോദ്യം ഇതാണ് ജീൻ ഹെൻറി ഡ്യൂനന്റിനെ റെഡ് ക്രോസ് സ്ഥാപിക്കാൻ പ്രേരിപ്പിച്ച യുദ്ധം ഏതാണ്? ഉത്തരം സോൾഫെറിനോ യുദ്ധം. 1859 ൽ നടന്ന സോൾഫെറിനോ യുദ്ധമാണ് ജീൻ ഹെൻറി ഡ്യൂനന്റിനെ റെഡ് ക്രോസ് സ്ഥാപിക്കാൻ പ്രേരിപ്പിച്ചത്. ഏതാണ് യുദ്ധം? സോൾഫെറിനോ യുദ്ധം. മറന്നുപോകരുത് സോൾഫെറിനോ യുദ്ധം. നമുക്ക് അടുത്ത ചോദ്യത്തിലേക്ക് കടക്കാം. ജീൻ ഹെൻറി ഡ്യൂനന്റ് എഴുതിയ പ്രശസ്തമായ ഗ്രന്ഥം ഏതാണ്? ജീൻ ഹെൻറി ഡ്യൂനന്റ് എഴുതിയ പ്രശസ്തമായ ഗ്രന്ഥം ഏതാണ്? ഉത്തരം എ മെമ്മറി ഓഫ് സോൾഫെറിനോ എന്താണ്? എ മെമ്മറി ഓഫ് സോൾഫെറിനോ. ജീൻ ഹെൻറി ഡ്യൂനന്റ് എഴുതിയ പ്രശസ്തമായ ഗ്രന്ഥമാണ് എ മെമ്മറി ഓഫ് സോൾഫെറിനോ. അടുത്ത ചോദ്യം. ഇന്ത്യൻ റെഡ് ക്രോസ് സൊസൈറ്റിയുടെ ആസ്ഥാനം എവിടെയാണ്? ഇന്ത്യൻ റെഡ് ക്രോസ് സൊസൈറ്റിയുടെ ആസ്ഥാനം എവിടെയാണ്? ഉത്തരം നോക്കൂ ന്യൂഡൽഹി. ഇന്ത്യൻ റെഡ് ക്രോസ് സൊസൈറ്റിയുടെ ആസ്ഥാനം വരുന്നത് ന്യൂഡൽഹി ആണ്. പ്രധാനപ്പെട്ടൊരു ചോദ്യമാണ് ഇന്ത്യൻ റെഡ് ക്രോസ് സൊസൈറ്റിയുടെ ആസ്ഥാനം വരുന്നത് ന്യൂഡൽഹി. അടുത്ത ചോദ്യം. ഇന്ത്യൻ റെഡ് ക്രോസ് സൊസൈറ്റിയുടെ ഇപ്പോഴത്തെ പ്രസിഡന്റ് ആരാണ്? ഇന്ത്യൻ റെഡ് ക്രോസ് സൊസൈറ്റിയുടെ ഇപ്പോഴത്തെ പ്രസിഡന്റ് ആരാണ്? ഉത്തരം ഇന്ത്യയുടെ രാഷ്ട്രപതിയാണ്. ഇന്ത്യയുടെ രാഷ്ട്രപതിയാണ് ഇന്ത്യൻ റെഡ് ക്രോസ് സൊസൈറ്റിയുടെ ഇപ്പോഴത്തെ പ്രസിഡന്റ്. അപ്പൊ ഇപ്പോഴത്തെ രാഷ്ട്രപതി ആരാണ്? ശ്രീമതി ദ്രൗപദി മുർമു. ഇന്ത്യയുടെ നിലവിലെയും പതിനഞ്ചാമത്തെയും രാഷ്ട്രപതിയായിട്ടുള്ള ശ്രീമതി ദ്രൗപദി മുർമു ആണ് ഇന്ത്യൻ റെഡ് ക്രോസ് സൊസൈറ്റിയുടെ ഇപ്പോഴത്തെ പ്രസിഡന്റ്. അടുത്ത ചോദ്യം നോക്കിക്കോളൂ. ഇന്ത്യയിൽ റെഡ് ക്രോസ് പ്രവർത്തനം ആരംഭിച്ച വർഷം ഏതാണ്? ഇന്ത്യയിൽ റെഡ് ക്രോസ് പ്രവർത്തനം ആരംഭിച്ച വർഷം ഏതാണ്? ഉത്തരം വരുന്നത് 1920. ഇന്ത്യയിൽ റെഡ് ക്രോസ് പ്രവർത്തനം ആരംഭിച്ച വർഷം 1920
